20.11.d: इ॒न्द्रः पूर्भि॒द् आ॒तिरद् दा॒सम् अर्कै॒र् विद॒द्वसुर् द॒यमानो वि॒ श॒त्रून् । ब्र॒ह्मजूतस् तन्वा॑ वावृधानो॒ भू॒रिदात्र आ॒पृणद् रो॒दसी उभे॒ ॥१॥
20.11.e: Fort-render, Lord of Wealth, dispelling foemen, Indra with lightnings hath o'ercome the Dāsa. Impelled by prayer and waxen great in body, he hath filled earth and heaven, the bounteous Giver.

20.11.d: मख॒स्य ते तविष॒स्य प्र॒ जूति॒म् इ॒यर्मि वा॒चम् अमृ॒ताय भू॒षन् । इ॒न्द्र क्षितीना॒म् असि मा॒नुषीणां विशां॒ दै॒वीनाम् उत॒ पूर्वया॒वा ॥२॥
20.11.e: I stimulate this zeal, the Strong, the Hero, decking my song of praise for thee Immortal. O Indra, thou art equally the leader of heavenly hosts and human generations.

20.11.d: इ॒न्द्रो वृत्र॒म् अवृणोच् छ॒र्धनीतिः प्र॒ मायि॒नाम् अमिनाद् व॒र्पणीतिः । अ॒हन् व्यं॑सम् उश॒धग् व॒नेष्व् आवि॒र् धे॒ना अकृणोद् राम्या॒णाम् ॥३॥
20.11.e: Leading his band Indra encompassed Vritra; weak grew the wily leader enchanters. He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyansa, and made the milch-kine of nights apparent.

20.11.d: इ॒न्द्रः स्वर्षा॒ जन॒यन्न् अ॒हानि जिगा॒योशि॒ग्भिः पृ॒तना अभिष्टिः॒ । प्रा॒रोचयन् म॒नवे केतु॒म् अ॒ह्नाम् अ॒विन्दज् ज्यो॒तिर् बृहते॒ र॒णाय ॥४॥
20.11.e: Indra, light-winner, days' creator, conquered, as guardian, hostile bands with those who loved him. For man the days' bright ensign he illumined, and found the light for his great joy and gladness.

20.11.d: इ॒न्द्रस् तु॒जो बर्ह॒णा आ॒ विवेश नृव॒द् द॒धानो न॒र्या पुरू॒णि । अ॒चेतयद् धि॒य इमा॒ जरित्रे॒ प्रे॒मं॒ व॒र्णम् अतिरच् छुक्र॒म् आसाम् ॥५॥
20.11.e: Forward to fiercely falling blows pressed Indra, hero-like doing many hero exploits. Those holy songs he taught the bard who praised him, and widely spread these Dawns' resplendent colour.

20.11.d: महो॒ महा॒नि पनयन्त्य् अस्ये॒न्द्रस्य क॒र्म सु॒कृता पुरू॒णि । वृज॒नेन वृजिना॒न्त् सं॒ पिपेष माया॒भिर् दस्यूं॒र् अभि॒भूत्योजाः ॥६॥
20.11.e: They laud the mighty acts of him the mighty, the many glorious deeds performed by Indra. He in his strength, with all-surpassing prowess, through wond- rous arts crushed the malignant Dasyus.

20.11.d: युधे॒न्द्रो मह्ना॒ व॒रिवश् चकार देवे॒भ्यः स॒त्पतिश् चर्षणिप्राः॒ । विव॒स्वतः स॒दने अस्य ता॒नि वि॒प्रा उक्थे॒भिः कव॒यो गृणन्ति ॥७॥
20.11.e: Lord of the brave, Indra who rules the people gave freedom to the Gods by might and battle. Wise singers glorify with chanted praises these his achievements in Vivasvān's dwelling.

20.11.d: सत्रासा॒हं व॒रेण्यं सहोदां॒ ससवां॒सं स्व॑र् अप॒श् च देवीः॒ । ससा॒न यः॒ पृथिवीं॒ द्या॒म् उते॒मा॒म् इ॒न्द्रं मदन्त्य् अ॒नु धी॒रणासः ॥८॥
20.11.e: Excellent, conqueror, the victory-giver, the winner of the light and godlike waters, He who hath won this broad earth and this heaven,—in Indra they rejoice who love devotions.

20.11.d: ससा॒ना॒त्यां उत॒ सू॒र्यं ससाने॒न्द्रः ससान पुरुभो॒जसं गा॒म् । हिरण्य॒यम् उत॒ भो॒गं ससान हत्वी॒ द॒स्यून् प्रा॒र्यं व॒र्णम् आवत् ॥९॥
20.11.e: He gained possession of the Sun and horses; Indra obtained the cow who feedeth many. Treasure of gold he won; he smote the Dasyus and gave protec- tion to the race of Aryas.

20.11.d: इ॒न्द्र ओ॒षधीर् असनोद् अ॒हानि व॒नस्प॒तींर् असनोद् अन्त॒रिक्षम् । बिभे॒द बलं॒ नुनुदे॒ वि॒वाचो॒ ऽथाभवद् दमिता॒भि॒क्रतूनाम् ॥१०॥
20.11.e: He took the plants and days for his possession; he gained the forest trees and air's mid-region. Vala he cleft, and chased away opponents: thus was he tamer of the overweening.

20.11.d: शुनं॒ हुवेम मघ॒वानम् इ॒न्द्रम् अस्मि॒न् भ॒रे नृ॒तमं वा॒जसातौ । शृण्व॒न्तम् उग्र॒म् ऊत॒ये सम॒त्सु घ्न॒न्तं वृत्रा॒णि संजि॒तं ध॒नानाम् ॥११॥
20.11.e: Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered, The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vritras, wins and gathers treasures.

20.12.d: उ॒द् उ ब्र॒ह्माण्य् ऐरत श्रवस्ये॒न्द्रं समर्ये॒ महया वसिष्ठ । आ॒ यो॒ वि॒श्वानि श॒वसा तता॒नोपश्रोता॒ म ई॒वतो व॒चांसि ॥१॥
20.12.e: Prayers have been offered up through love of glory: Vasishtha, honour Indra in the battle. He who with might extends through all existence hears words which I, his faithful servant, utter.

20.12.d: अ॒यामि घो॒ष इन्द्र देव॒जामिर् इरज्य॒न्त य॒च् छुरु॒धो वि॒वाचि । नहि॒ स्व॒म् आ॒युश् चिकिते॒ ज॒नेषु ता॒नी॒द् अं॒हांस्य् अ॒ति पर्ष्य् अस्मा॒न् ॥२॥
20.12.e: A cry was raised which reached the Gods, O Indra, a cry to them to send us strength in combat. None among men knows his own life's duration: bear us in safety over these our troubles.

20.12.d: युजे॒ र॒थं गवे॒षणं ह॒रिभ्याम् उ॒प ब्र॒ह्माणि जुजुषाण॒म् अस्थुः । वि॒ बाधिष्ट स्य॒ रो॒दसी महित्वे॒न्द्रो वृत्रा॒ण्य् अप्रती॒ जघन्वा॒न् ॥३॥
20.12.e: The Bays, the booty-seeking car I harness: my prayers have reached him who accepts them gladly. Indra, when he had slain resistless Vritras, forced with his might the two world-halves asunder.

20.12.d: आ॒पश् चित् पिप्यु स्तर्यो॑ न॒ गा॒वो न॒क्षन्न् ऋतं॒ जरिता॒रस् त इन्द्र । याहि॒ वायु॒र् न॒ नियु॒तो नो अ॒छा त्वं॒ हि॒ धीभि॒र् द॒यसे वि॒ वा॒जान् ॥४॥
20.12.e: Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: the singers sought thy holy rite, O Indra. Come unto us as with his team comes Vāyu: thou, through our solemn hymns, bestowest booty.

20.12.d: ते॒ त्वा म॒दा इन्द्र मादयन्तु शुष्मि॒णं तुविरा॒धसं जरित्रे॒ । ए॒को देवत्रा॒ द॒यसे हि॒ म॒र्तान् अस्मि॒न् छूर स॒वने मादयस्व ॥५॥
20.12.e: So may these gladdening draughts rejoice thee, Indra, the Mighty, very bounteous to the singer. Alone among the Gods thou pitiest mortals: O Hero, make thee glad at this libation.

20.12.d: एवे॒द् इ॒न्द्रं वृ॒षणं व॒ज्रबाहुं व॒सिष्ठासो अभ्य् अ॑र्चन्त्य् अर्कैः॒ । स॒ न स्तुतो॒ वीर॒वद् धातु गो॒मद् यूयं॒ पात स्वस्ति॒भिः स॒दा नः ॥६॥
20.12.e: Thus the Vasishthas glorify with praises Indra, the Mighty One, whose arm wields thunder. Praised, may he guard our wealth in kine and heroes. Ye Gods,. preserve us evermore with blessings.

20.12.d: ऋजीषी॒ वज्री॒ वृषभ॒स् तुराषा॒ट् छुष्मी॒ रा॒जा वृत्रहा॒ सोमपा॒वा । युक्त्वा॒ ह॒रिभ्याम् उ॒प यासद् अर्वा॒ङ् मा॒ध्यंदिने स॒वने मत्सद् इ॒न्द्रः ॥७॥
20.12.e: Impetuous, Thunderer, strong, quelling the mighty, King, potent, Vritra-slayer, Soma-drinker, May he come hither with his yoked bay horses. May Indra glad- den him at noon libation.

20.13.d: इ॒न्द्रश् च सो॒मं पिबतं बृहस्पते ऽस्मि॒न् यज्ञे॒ मन्दसाना॒ वृषण्वसू । आ॒ वां विशन्त्व् इ॒न्दवः स्वाभु॒वो ऽस्मे॒ रयिं॒ स॒र्ववीरं नि॒ यछतम् ॥१॥
20.13.e: Lords of great wealth, Brihaspati and Indra, rejoicing at this sacrifice drink Soma. Let the abundant drops sink deep within you: vouchsafe us riches with full store of heroes.

20.13.d: आ॒ वो वहन्तु स॒प्तयो रघुष्य॒दो रघुप॒त्वानः प्र॒ जिगात बाहु॒भिः । सीदता बर्हि॒र् उरु॒ वः स॒दस् कृतं॒ माद॒यध्वं मरुतो म॒ध्वो अ॒न्धसः ॥२॥
20.13.e: Let your swift-gliding coursers bear you hitherward with their fleet pinions. Come ye forward with your arms. Sit on the grass; a wide seat hath been made for you: delight yourselves, O Maruts, in the pleasant food.

20.13.d: इमं॒ स्तो॒मम् अ॒र्हते जात॒वेदसे र॒थम् इव सं॒ महेमा मनीष॒या । भद्रा॒ हि॒ नः प्र॒मतिर् अस्य संस॒द्य् अ॒ग्ने सख्ये॒ मा॒ रिषामा वयं॒ त॒व ॥३॥
20.13.e: For Jātavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car. For good in his assembly is this care of ours. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

20.13.d: ऐ॒भिर् अग्ने सर॒थं याह्य् अर्वा॒ङ् नानारथं॒ वा विभ॒वो ह्य् अ॒श्वाः । प॒त्नीवतस् त्रिंश॒तं त्रीं॒श् च देवा॒न् अनुष्वध॒म् आ॒ वह माद॒यस्व ॥४॥
20.13.e: With these, borne on one car, Agni, approach us; or borne on many, for thy steeds are able. Bring, with their Dames, the Gods, the Three-and-Thirty, after thy Godlike nature, and he joyful.

20.14.d: वय॒म् उ त्वा॒म् अपूर्व्य स्थूरं॒ न॒ क॒च् चिद् भ॒रन्तो ऽवस्य॒वः । वा॒जे चित्रं॒ हवामहे ॥१॥
20.14.e: We call on thee, O peerless One. We, seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee wonderful in fight.

20.14.d: उ॒प त्वा क॒र्मन्न् ऊत॒ये स॒ नो यु॒वोग्र॒श् चक्राम यो॒ धृष॒त् । त्वा॒म् इ॒द् ध्य् अ॑विता॒रं ववृम॒हे स॒खाय इन्द्र सानसि॒म् ॥२॥
20.14.e: On thee for aid in sacrifice. This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gone forth. We, therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, free- giver, as our guardian God.

20.14.d: यो॒ न इद॒मिदं पुरा॒ प्र॒ व॒स्य आनिना॒य त॒म् उ व स्तुषे । स॒खाय इ॒न्द्रम् ऊत॒ये ॥३॥
20.14.e: Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you, Even Indra, O my friends, for help:

20.14.d: ह॒र्यश्वं स॒त्पतिं चर्षणीस॒हं स॒ हि॒ ष्मा यो॒ अ॒मन्दत । आ॒ तु नः स॒ वयति ग॒व्यम् अ॒श्व्यं स्तोतृ॒भ्यो मघ॒वा शत॒म् ॥४॥
20.14.e: Borne by bay steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes delight. The Bounteous Lord bestows on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds.

20.15.d: प्र॒ मं॒हिष्ठाय बृहते॒ बृह॒द्रये सत्य॒शुष्माय तव॒से मतिं॒ भरे । अपा॒म् इव प्रवणे॒ य॒स्य दुर्ध॒रं रा॒धो विश्वा॒यु श॒वसे अ॒पावृतम् ॥१॥
20.15.e: To him most liberal, lofty Lord of lofty wealth, verily powerful and strong, I bring my hymn, Whose checkless bounty, as of waters down a slope, is spread abroad for all that live, to give them strength.

20.15.d: अ॒ध ते वि॒श्वम् अ॒नु हासद् इष्ट॒य आ॒पो निम्ने॒व स॒वना हवि॒ष्मतः । य॒त् प॒र्वते न॒ सम॒शीत हर्यत॒ इ॒न्द्रस्य व॒ज्रः श्न॒थिता हिरण्य॒यः ॥२॥
20.15.e: Now all this world, for worship, shall come after thee—the offerer's libations like descending floods, When the well-loved one seems to rest upon the hill, the thun- derbolt of Indra, shatterer wrought of gold.

20.15.d: अस्मै॒ भीमा॒य न॒मसा स॒म् अध्वर॒ उ॒षो न॒ शुभ्र आ॒ भरा प॒नीयसे । य॒स्य धा॒म श्र॒वसे ना॒मेन्द्रियं॒ ज्यो॒तिर् अ॒कारि हरि॒तो ना॒यसे ॥३॥
20.15.e: To him the terrible, most worthy of high praise, like radiant Dawn, bring gifts with reverence in this rite, Whose being, for renown, yea, Indra-power and light, have been created, like bay steeds, to move with speed.

20.15.d: इमे॒ त इन्द्र ते॒ वयं॒ पुरुष्टुत ये॒ त्वार॒भ्य च॒रामसि प्रभूवसो । नहि॒ त्व॒द् अन्यो॒ गिर्वणो गि॒रः स॒धत् क्षोणी॒र् इव प्र॒ति नो हर्य त॒द् व॒चः ॥४॥
20.15.e: Thine, Indra, praised by many excellently rich! are we who trusting in thy help draw near to thee. Lover of praise, none else but thou receives our laud: as Earth loves all her creatures, love thou this our hymn.

20.15.d: भू॒रि त इन्द्र वीर्यं॑ त॒व स्मस्य् अस्य॒ स्तोतु॒र् मघवन् का॒मम् आ॒ पृण । अ॒नु ते द्यौ॒र् बृहती॒ वीर्यं॑ मम इयं॒ च ते पृथिवी॒ नेम ओ॒जसे ॥५॥
20.15.e: Great is thy power, O Indra, we are thine. Fulfil, O Maghavan, the wish of this thy worshipper. After thee lofty heaven hath measured out its strength to thee and to thy power this earth hath bowed itself.

20.15.d: त्वं॒ त॒म् इन्द्र प॒र्वतं महा॒म् उरुं॒ व॒ज्रेण वज्रिन् पर्वश॒श् चकर्तिथ । अ॒वासृजो नि॒वृताः स॒र्तवा॒ अपः॒ सत्रा॒ वि॒श्वं दधिषे के॒वलं स॒हः ॥६॥
20.15.e: Thou, who hast thunder for thy weapon, with thy bolt hast shattered into pieces this broad massive cloud. Thou hast sent down obstructed floods that they may flow: thou hast, thine own for ever, all victorious might.

20.16.d: उदप्रु॒तो न॒ व॒यो र॒क्षमाणा वा॒वदतो अभ्रि॒यस्येव घो॒षाः । गिरिभ्र॒जो नो॒र्म॒यो म॒दन्तो बृ॒हस्प॒तिम् अभ्य् अ॑र्का॒ अनावन् ॥१॥
20.16.e: Like birds who keep their watch, plashing in water, like the loud voices of the thundering rain-cloud, Like merry streamlets bursting from the mountain thus to Brihaspati our hymns have sounded.

20.16.d: सं॒ गो॒भिर् अङ्गिरसो॒ न॒क्षमाणो भ॒ग इवे॒द् अर्यम॒णं निनाय । ज॒ने मित्रो॒ न॒ द॒म्पती अनक्ति बृ॒हस्पते वाज॒याशूं॒र् इवाजौ॒ ॥२॥
20.16.e: The son of Angiras, meeting the cattle, as Bhaga, brought in Aryaman among us. As Friend of men he decks the wife and husband. As for the race, Brihaspati, nerve our coursers.

20.16.d: साध्वर्या॒ अतिथि॒नीर् इषिरा॒ स्पार्हाः॒ सुव॒र्णा अनवद्य॒रूपाः । बृ॒हस्प॒तिः प॒र्वतेभ्यो वितू॒र्या नि॒र् गा॒ ऊपे य॒वम् इव स्थिवि॒भ्यः ॥३॥
20.16.e: Brihaspati, having won them from the mountains, strewed down, like barley out of winnowing-baskets, The vigorous, wandering cows who aid the pious, desired of all, of blameless form, well-coloured.

20.16.d: आप्रुषाय॒न् म॒धुना ऋत॒स्य यो॒निम् अवक्षिप॒न्न् अर्क॒ उल्का॒म् इव द्योः॒ । बृ॒हस्प॒तिर् उद्ध॒रन्न् अ॒श्मनो गा॒ भू॒म्या उद्ने॒व वि॒ त्व॒चं बिभेद ॥४॥
20.16.e: As the Sun dews with meath the seat of Order, and casts a flam- ing meteor down from heaven, So from the rock Brihaspati forced the cattle, and cleft the earth's skin as it were with water.

20.16.d: अ॒प ज्यो॒तिषा त॒मो अन्त॒रिक्षद् उद्नः॒ शी॒पालम् इव वा॒त आजत् । बृ॒हस्प॒तिर् अनुमृ॒श्या वल॒स्याभ्र॒म् इव वा॒त आ॒ चक्र आ॒ गाः॒ ॥५॥
20.16.e: Forth from mid-air with light he draye the darkness, as the gale blows a lily from the river. Like the wind grasping at the cloud of Vala, Brihaspati gathered to himself the cattle.

20.16.d: यदा॒ वल॒स्य पी॒यतो ज॒सुं भे॒द् बृ॒हस्प॒तिर् अग्नित॒पोभिर् अर्कैः॒ । दद्भि॒र् न॒ जिह्वा॒ प॒रिविष्टम् आ॒दद् आवि॒र् निधीं॒र् अकृणोद् उस्रि॒याणाम् ॥६॥
20.16.e: Brihaspati, when he with fiery lightnings cleft through the weapon of reviling Vala, Consumed him as tongues eat what teeth have compassed: he threw the prisons of the red cows open.

20.16.d: बृ॒हस्प॒तिर् अ॒मत हि॒ त्य॒द् आसां ना॒म स्वरी॒णां स॒दने गु॒हा य॒त् । आण्डे॒व भित्वा॒ शकुन॒स्य ग॒र्भम् उ॒द् उस्रि॒याः प॒र्वतस्य त्म॒नाजत् ॥७॥
20.16.e: That secret name borne by the lowing cattle within the cave Brihaspati discovered, And draye, himself, the bright kine from the mountain, like a bird's young after the eggs' disclosure.

20.16.d: अ॒श्ना॒पिनद्धं म॒धु प॒र्य् अपश्यन् म॒त्स्यं न॒ दीन॒ उद॒नि क्षिय॒न्तम् । नि॒ष् ट॒ज् जभार चमसं॒ न॒ वृक्षा॒द् बृ॒हस्प॒तिर् विरवे॒णा विकृ॒त्य ॥८॥
20.16.e: He looked around on rock-imprisoned sweetness as one who eyes a fish in scanty water. Brihaspati, cleaving through with varied clamour, brought it forth like a bowl from out the timber.

20.16.d: सो॒षा॒म् अविन्दत् स॒ स्वः॑ सो॒ अग्निं॒ सो॒ अर्के॒ण वि॒ बबाधे त॒मांसि । बृ॒हस्प॒तिर् गो॒वपुषो वल॒स्य नि॒र् मज्जा॒नं न॒ प॒र्वणो जभार ॥९॥
20.16.e: He found the light of heaven, and fire, and Morning: with lucid rays he forced apart the darkness. As from a joint, Brihaspati took the marrow of Vala as he gloried in his cattle.

20.16.d: हिमे॒व पर्णा॒ मुषिता॒ व॒नानि बृ॒हस्प॒तिनाकृपयद् वलो॒ गाः॒ । अनानुकृत्य॒म् अपुन॒श् चकार या॒त् सू॒र्यामा॒सा मिथ॒ उच्च॒रातः ॥१०॥
20.16.e: As trees for foliage robbed by winter, Vala mourned for the cows Brihaspati had taken. He did a deed ne'er done, ne'er to be equalled, whereby the sun and moon ascend alternate.

20.16.d: अभि॒ श्यावं॒ न॒ कृ॒शनेभिर् अ॒श्वं न॒क्षत्रेभिः पित॒रो द्या॒म् अपिंशन् । रा॒त्र्यां त॒मो अ॒दधुर् ज्यो॒तिर् अ॒हन् बृ॒हस्प॒तिर् भिन॒द् अ॒द्रिं विद॒द् गाः॒ ॥११॥
20.16.e: Like a dark steed adorned with pearl, the Fathers have decorat- ed heaven with constellations. They set the light in day, in night the darkness, Brihaspati cleft the rock and found the cattle.

20.16.d: इद॒म् अकर्म न॒मो अभ्रिया॒य यः॒ पूर्वी॒र् अ॒न्व् आनो॒नवीति । बृ॒हस्प॒तिः स॒ हि॒ गो॒भिः सो॒ अ॒श्वैः स॒ वीरे॒भिः स॒ नृ॒भिर् नो व॒यो धात् ॥१२॥
20.16.e: This homage have we offered to the Cloud-God who thunders out to many in succession. May this Brihaspati vouchsafe us fulness of life with kine and horses, men, and heroes.

20.17.d: अ॒छा म इ॒न्द्रं मत॒यः स्वर्वि॒दः सध्री॒चीर् वि॒श्वा उशती॒र् अनूषत । प॒रि ष्वजन्ते ज॒नयो य॒था प॒तिं म॒र्यं न॒ शुन्ध्युं॒ मघ॒वानम् ऊत॒ये ॥१॥
20.17.e: In perfect unison all yearning hymns of mine that find the light of heaven have sung forth Indra's praise. As wives embrace their lord, the comely bridegroom, so they compass Maghavan about that he may help.

20.17.d: न॒ घा त्वद्रि॒ग् अ॒प वेति मे म॒नस् त्वे॒ इ॒त् का॒मं पुरुहूत शिश्रय । रा॒जेव दस्म नि॒ षदो॒ ऽधि बर्हि॒ष्य् अस्मि॒न्त् सु॒ सो॒मे ऽवपा॒नम् अस्तु ते ॥२॥
20.17.e: Directed unto thee my spirit never strays, for I have set my hopes on thee, O much-invoked! Sit, wonderful! as King upon the sacred grass, and let thy drinking-place be by the Soma juice.

20.17.d: विषूवृ॒द् इ॒न्द्रो अ॒मुतेर् उत॒ क्षुधः॒ स॒ इ॒द् रायो॒ मघ॒वा व॒स्व ईशते । त॒स्ये॒द् इमे॒ प्रवणे॒ सप्त॒ सि॒न्धवो व॒यो वर्धन्ति वृषभ॒स्य शुष्मि॒णः ॥३॥
20.17.e: From indigence and hunger Indra turns away: Maghavan hath dominion over precious wealth. These the Seven Rivers flowing on their downward path increase the vital vigour of the Mighty Steer.

20.17.d: व॒यो न॒ वृक्षं॒ सुपलाश॒म् आ॒सदन्त् सो॒मास इ॒न्द्रं मन्दि॒नश् चमूष॒दः । प्रै॒षाम् अ॒नीकं श॒वसा द॒विद्युतद् विद॒त् स्व॑र् म॒नवे ज्यो॒तिर् आ॒र्यम् ॥४॥
20.17.e: As on the fair-leafed tree rest birds, to Indra flow the gladden- ing Soma juices that the bowls contain. Their face that glows with splendour through their mighty power hath found the shine of heaven for man, the Aryas' light.

20.17.d: कृतं॒ न॒ श्वघ्नी॒ वि॒ चिनोति दे॒वने संव॒र्गं य॒न् मघ॒वा सू॒र्यं ज॒यत् । न॒ त॒त् ते अन्यो॒ अ॒नु वीर्यं॑ शकन् न॒ पुराणो॒ मघवन् नो॒त॒ नू॒तनः ॥५॥
20.17.e: As in the game a gambler piles his winnings, so Maghavan, sweeping all together, gained the Sun. This mighty deed of thine none other could achieve, none, Maghavan, before thee, none in recent time.

20.17.d: वि॒शंविशं मघ॒वा प॒र्य् अशायत ज॒नानां धे॒ना अवचा॒कशद् वृ॒षा । य॒स्या॒ह शक्रः॒ स॒वनेषु र॒ण्यति स॒ तीव्रैः॒ सो॒मैः सहते पृतन्यतः॒ ॥६॥
20.17.e: Maghavan came by turns to all the tribes of men: the Steer took notice of the people's songs of praise. The man in whose libations Sakra hath delight by means of potent Somas vanquisheth his foes.

20.17.d: आ॒पो न॒ सि॒न्धुम् अभि॒ य॒त् सम॒क्षरन्त् सो॒मास इ॒न्द्रं कुल्या॒ इव ह्रद॒म् । व॒र्धन्ति वि॒प्रा म॒हो अस्य सा॒दने य॒वं न॒ वृष्टि॒र् दिव्ये॒न दा॒नुना ॥७॥
20.17.e: As waters flow together to the river, thus Somas to Indra flow, as rivulets to the lake. In place of sacrifice sages exalt his might, as the rain swells the corn by moisture sent from heaven.

20.17.d: वृ॒षा न॒ क्रुद्धः॒ पतयद् र॒जःस्व् आ॒ यो॒ अर्य॒पत्नीर् अ॒कृणोद् इमा॒ अपः॒ । स॒ सुन्वते॒ मघ॒वा जीर॒दानवे॒ ऽविन्दज् ज्यो॒तिर् म॒नवे हवि॒ष्मते ॥८॥
20.17.e: He rushes through the region like a furious bull, he who hath made these floods the dames of worthy lords. This Maghavan hath found light for the man who brings oblation, sheds the juice, and promptly pours his gifts.

20.17.d: उ॒ज् जायतां परशु॒ ज्यो॒तिषा सह॒ भूया॒ ऋत॒स्य सुदु॒घा पुराणव॒त् । वि॒ रोचताम् अरुषो॒ भानु॒ना शु॒चिः स्व॑र् न॒ शुक्रं॒ शुशुचीत स॒त्पतिः ॥९॥
20.17.e: Let the keen axe come forth together with the light: here be, as erst, the teeming cow of sacrifice. Let the Red God shine pure with his refulgent ray, and let the Lord of heroes glow like heaven's clear sheen.

20.17.d: गो॒भिष् टरेमा॒मतिं दुरे॒वां य॒वेन क्षु॒धं पुरुहूत वि॒श्वाम् । वयं॒ रा॒जभिः प्रथमा॒ ध॒नान्य् अस्मा॒केन वृज॒नेना जयेम ॥१०॥
20.17.e: O much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes, obtain possessions by our own exertion.

20.17.d: बृ॒हस्प॒तिर् नः प॒रि पातु पश्चा॒द् उतो॒त्तरस्माद् अ॒धराद् अघायोः॒ । इ॒न्द्रः पुर॒स्ताद् उत॒ मध्यतो॒ नः स॒खा स॒खिभ्यः व॒रिवः कृणोतु ॥११॥
20.17.e: Brihaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners. May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

20.17.d: बृ॒हस्पते युव॒म् इ॒न्द्रश् च व॒स्वो दिव्य॒स्येशाथे उत॒ पा॒र्थिवस्य । धत्तं॒ रयिं॒ स्तुवते॒ कीर॒ये चिद् यूयं॒ पात स्वस्ति॒भिः स॒दा नः ॥१२॥
20.17.e: Ye twain are Lords of wealth in earth and heaven, thou, O Brihaspati, and thou, O Indra. Mean though he be, give wealth to him who lauds you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

20.18.d: वय॒म् उ त्वा तदि॒तर्था इ॒न्द्र त्वाय॒न्तः स॒खायः । क॒ण्वा उक्थे॒भिर् जरन्ते ॥१॥
20.18.e: This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends, The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns.

20.18.d: न॒ घेम् अन्य॒द् आ॒ पपन व॒ज्रिन्न् अप॒सो न॒विष्टौ । त॒वे॒द् उ स्तो॒मं चिकेत ॥२॥
20.18.e: Naught else, O Thunderer, have I praised in the skilled singer's eulogy: On thy laud only have I thought.

20.18.d: इछ॒न्ति देवाः॒ सुन्व॒न्तं न॒ स्व॒प्नाय स्पृहयन्ति । य॒न्ति प्रमा॒दम् अ॒तन्द्राः ॥३॥
20.18.e: The Gods seek him who presses out the Soma; they desire not sleep: Incessantly they punish sloth.

20.18.d: वय॒म् इन्द्र त्वाय॒वो ऽभि॒ प्र॒ णोनुमो वृषन् । विद्धि॒ त्व् अ॑स्य॒ नो वसो ॥४॥
20.18.e: Faithful to thee we loudly sing, heroic Indra, songs to thee. Mark, gracious Lord, this act of ours.

20.18.d: मा॒ नो निदे॒ च व॒क्तवे ऽर्यो॒ रन्धीर् अ॒राव्ने । त्वे॒ अ॒पि क्र॒तुर् म॒म ॥५॥
20.18.e: Give us not up to man's reproach, to foeman's hateful calumny: In thee alone is all my strength.

20.18.d: त्वं॒ व॒र्मासि सप्र॒थः पुरोयोध॒श् च वृत्रहन् । त्व॒या प्र॒ति ब्रुवे युजा॒ ॥६॥
20.18.e: Thou art mine ample coat of mail, my champion, Vritra-slayes, thou. With thee for Friend I brave the foe.

20.19.d: वा॒र्त्रहत्याय श॒वसे पृतनाषा॒ह्याय च । इ॒न्द्र त्वा॒ वर्तयामसि ॥१॥
20.19.e: O Indra, for the strength that slays the foe and conquers in the fight We turn thee hitherward to us.

20.19.d: अर्वाची॒नं सु॒ ते म॒न उत॒ च॒क्षुः शतक्रतो । इ॒न्द्र कृण्व॒न्तु वाघ॒तः ॥२॥
20.19.e: O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers, may those who praise thee hitherward. Direct thy spirit and thine eye.

20.19.d: ना॒मानि ते शतक्रतो वि॒श्वाभिर् गीर्भि॒र् ईमहे । इ॒न्द्राभिमातिषा॒ह्ये ॥३॥
20.19.e: O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers, with all our songs we invocate. Thy names for triumph over foes.

20.19.d: पुरुष्टुत॒स्य धा॒मभिः शते॒न महयामसि । इ॒न्द्रस्य चर्षणीधृ॒तः ॥४॥
20.19.e: We strive for glory through the powers immense of him whom many praise, Of Indra who supports mankind.

20.19.d: इ॒न्द्रं वृत्रा॒य ह॒न्तवे पुरुहूत॒म् उ॒प ब्रुवे । भ॒रेषु वा॒जसातये ॥५॥
20.19.e: For the foe's slaughter I address Indra whom many invocate, To win us booty in the wars.

20.19.d: वा॒जेषु सासहि॒र् भव त्वा॒म् ईमहे शतक्रतो । इ॒न्द्र वृत्रा॒य ह॒न्तवे ॥६॥
20.19.e: In battles be victorious. We seek thee, Lord of Hundred Powers, O Indra, that the foe may fall.

20.19.d: द्युम्ने॒षु पृतना॒ज्ये पृत्सुतू॒र्षु श्र॒वःसु च । इ॒न्द्र सा॒क्ष्वाभि॒मातिषु ॥७॥
20.19.e: In splendid combats of the hosts, in glories where the fight is won, Indra, be victor over foes.

20.20.d: शुष्मि॒न्तमं न ऊत॒ये द्युम्नि॒नं पाहि जा॒गृविम् । इ॒न्द्र सो॒मं शतक्रतो ॥१॥
20.20.e: Drink thou the Soma for our help, bright, vigilant, exceeding strong, O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers.

20.20.d: इन्द्रिया॒णि शतक्रतो या॒ ते ज॒नेषु पञ्च॒सु । इ॒न्द्र ता॒नि त आ॒ वृणे ॥२॥
20.20.e: O Satakratu, powers which thou mid the Five Races hast dis- played These, Indra, do I claim of thee.

20.20.d: अ॒गन्न् इन्द्र श्र॒वो बृह॒द् द्युम्नं॒ दधिष्व दुष्ट॒रम् । उ॒त् ते शु॒ष्मं तिरामसि ॥३॥
20.20.e: Indra, great glory hast thou gained. Win splendid fame which none may mar: We make thy might perpetual.

20.20.d: अर्वाव॒तो न आ॒ गह्य् अ॒थो शक्र पराव॒तः । उ लोको॒ य॒स् ते अद्रिव इ॒न्द्रेह॒ त॒त आ॒ गहि ॥४॥
20.20.e: Come to us either from anear, or, Sakra, come from far away. Indra, wherever be thy home, come to us thence, O Thunder- armed.

20.20.d: इ॒न्द्रो अङ्गं॒ मह॒द् भय॒म् अभि॒ ष॒द् अ॒प चुच्यवत् । स॒ हि॒ स्थिरो॒ वि॒चर्षणिः ॥५॥
20.20.e: Verily Indra, conquering all, driveth even mighty fear away; For firm is he and swift to act.

20.20.d: इ॒न्द्रश् च मृल॒याति नो न॒ नः पश्चा॒द् अघं॒ नशत् । भद्रं॒ भवाति नः पुरः॒ ॥६॥
20.20.e: Indra be gracious unto us: sin shall not reach us afterward . And good shall be before us still,

20.20.d: इ॒न्द्र आ॒शाभ्यस् प॒रि स॒र्वाभ्यो अ॒भयं करत् । जे॒ता श॒त्रून् वि॒चर्षणिः ॥७॥
20.20.e: From all the regions of the world let Indra send security. The foe-subduer, swift to act.

20.21.d: न्य् ऊ षु॒ वा॒चं प्र॒ महे॒ भरामहे गि॒र इ॒न्द्राय स॒दने विव॒स्वतः । नू॒ चिद् धि॒ र॒त्नं ससता॒म् इवा॒विदन् न॒ दुष्टुति॒र् द्रविणोदे॒षु शस्यते ॥१॥
20.21.e: We will present fair praise unto the Mighty One, our hymns to Indra in Vivasvān's dwelling-place; For he hath ne'er found wealth in those who seem to sleep; those who give wealth to men accept no paltry praise.

20.21.d: दुरो॒ अ॒श्वस्य दुर॒ इन्द्र गो॒र् असि दुरो॒ य॒वस्य व॒सुन इन॒स् प॒तिः । शिक्षानरः॒ प्रदि॒वो अ॒कामकर्शनः स॒खा स॒खिभ्यस् त॒म् इदं॒ गृणीमसि ॥२॥
20.21.e: Giver of horses, Indra, giver, thou, of kine, giver of barley, thou art Lord and guard of wealth: Man's helper from of old, not disappointing hope, Friend of our friends, to thee as such we sing this praise.

20.21.d: श॒चीव इन्द्र पुरुकृद् द्युमत्तम त॒वे॒द् इद॒म् अभि॒तश् चेकिते व॒सु । अ॒तः संगृ॒भ्याभिभूत आ॒ भर मा॒ त्वायतो॒ जरितुः॒ का॒मम् ऊनयीः ॥३॥
20.21.e: Indra, most splendid, powerful, rich in mighty deeds, this treasure spread around is known to be thine own. Gather therefrom. O Conqueror, and bring to us: fail not the hope of him who loves and sings to thee.

20.21.d: एभि॒र् द्यु॒भिर् सुम॒ना एभि॒र् इ॒न्दुभिर् निरुन्धानो॒ अ॒मतिं गो॒भिर् अश्वि॒ना । इ॒न्द्रेण द॒स्युं दर॒यन्त इ॒न्दुभिर् युत॒द्वेषसः सम् इषा॒ रभेमहि ॥४॥
20.21.e: Well-pleased with these bright flames and with these Soma drops, take thou away our poverty with steeds and kine. With Indra scattering the Dasyu through these drops, freed from their hate may we obtain abundant food.

20.21.d: स॒म् इन्द्र राया॒ स॒म् इषा॒ रभेमहि सं॒ वा॒जेभिः पुरुश्चन्द्रै॒र् अभि॒द्युभिः । सं॒ देव्या॒ प्र॒मत्या वीर॒शुष्मया गो॒अग्रया॒श्वावत्या रभेमहि ॥५॥
20.21.e: Let us obtain, O Indra, plenteous wealth and food, with strength exceeding glorious, shining to the sky. May we obtain the Goddess Providence, the strength of heroes, special source of cattle, rich in steeds.

20.21.d: ते॒ त्वा म॒दा अमदन् ता॒नि वृ॒ष्ण्या ते सो॒मासो वृत्रह॒त्येषु सत्पते । य॒त् कार॒वे द॒श वृत्रा॒ण्य् अप्रति॒ बर्हि॒ष्मते नि॒ सह॒स्राणि बर्ह॒यः ॥६॥
20.21.e: These our libations, strength inspiring Soma draughts, gladdened thee in the fight with Vritra, Hero-Lord, What time thou slewest for the singer with trimmed grass ten thousand Vritras, thou resistless in thy might.

20.21.d: युधा॒ यु॒धम् उ॒प घे॒द् एषि धृष्णुया॒ पुरा॒ पु॒रं स॒म् इदं॒ हंस्य् ओ॒जसा । न॒म्या य॒द् इन्द्र स॒ख्या पराव॒ति निबर्ह॒यो न॒मुचिं ना॒म मायि॒नम् ॥७॥
20.21.e: Thou goest on from fight to fight intrepidly, destroying castle after castle here with strength; Thou Indra, with thy friend who makes the foe bow down, slewest from far away the guileful Namuchi.

20.21.d: त्वं॒ क॒रञ्जम् उत॒ पर्ण॒यं वधीस् ते॒जिष्ठयातिथिग्व॒स्य वर्तनी॒ । त्वं॒ शता॒ व॒ङ्गृदस्याभिनत् पु॒रो ऽनानुदः॒ प॒रिषूता ऋजि॒श्वना ॥८॥
20.21.e: Thou hast stuck down in death Karanja, Parnaya, in Atithigva's very glorious going forth: Unyielding, when Rijisvan compassed them with siege, thou hast destroyed the hundred towns of Vangrida.

20.21.d: त्व॒म् एतां॒ जनरा॒ज्ञो द्वि॒र् द॒शाबन्धु॒ना सुश्र॒वसोपजग्मु॒षः । षष्टिं॒ सह॒स्रा नवतिं॒ न॒व श्रुतो॒ नि॒ चक्रे॒ण र॒थ्या दुष्प॒दावृणक् ॥९॥
20.21.e: With all-outstripping chariot wheel, O Indra, thou far-famed, hast overthrown the twice ten kings of men, With sixty thousand nine-and-ninety followers, who came in arms to fight with friendless Susravas.

20.21.d: त्व॒म् आविथ सुश्र॒वसं त॒वोति॒भिस् त॒व त्रा॒मभिर् इन्द्र तू॒र्वयाणम् । त्व॒ अस्मै कु॒त्सम् अतिथिग्व॒म् आयुं॒ महे॒ रा॒ज्ञे यू॒ने अरन्धनायः ॥१०॥
20.21.e: Thou hast protected Susravas with succour, and Tūrvayāna with thine aid, O Indra: Thou madest Kutsa, Atithigva, Ayu subject unto this king, the young, the mighty.

20.21.d: य॒ उदृ॒चीन्द्र देव॒गोपाः स॒खायस् ते शिव॒तमा अ॒साम । त्वां॒ स्तोषाम त्व॒या सुवी॒रा द्रा॒घीय आ॒युः प्रतरं॒ द॒धानाः ॥११॥
20.21.e: May we protected by the Gods hereafter remain thy very pro- sperous friends, O Indra. Thee we extol, enjoying through thy favour life-long and joyful and with store of heroes.

20.22.d: अभि॒ त्वा वृषभा सुते॒ सुतं॒ सृजामि पीत॒ये । तृम्पा॒ व्य् अ॑श्नुही म॒दम् ॥१॥
20.22.e: Hero, the Soma being pressed I pour the juice for thee to drink Sate thee and finish thy carouse.

20.22.d: मा॒ त्वा मूरा॒ अविष्य॒वो मो॒पह॒स्वान आ॒ दभन् । मा॒कीं ब्रह्मद्वि॒षो वनः ॥२॥
20.22.e: Let not the fools, or those who mock, beguile thee when they seek thine aid: Love not the enemies of prayer.

20.22.d: इह॒ त्वा गो॒परीणसा महे॒ मन्दन्तु रा॒धसे । स॒रो गौरो॒ य॒था पिब ॥३॥
20.22.e: Here let them with rich milky draught cheer thee to great munificence: Drink as the wild bull drinks the lake.

20.22.d: अभि॒ प्र॒ गो॒पतिं गिरे॒न्द्रम् अर्च य॒था विदे॒ । सूनुं॒ सत्य॒स्य स॒त्पतिम् ॥४॥
20.22.e: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra, the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.

20.22.d: आ॒ ह॒रयः ससृज्रिरे॒ ऽरुषीर् अ॒धि बर्हि॒षि । य॒त्राभि॒ संन॒वामहे ॥५॥
20.22.e: Hither his bay steeds have been sent, red steeds are on the sacred grass. Where we in concert sing our songs.

20.22.d: इ॒न्द्राय गा॒व आशि॒रं दुदुह्रे॒ वज्रि॒णे म॒धु । य॒त् सीम् उपह्वरे॒ विद॒त् ॥६॥
20.22.e: For Indra, Thunder-armed, the kine have yielded mingled milk and meath, What time he found them in the vault.

20.23.d: आ॒ तू॒ न इन्द्र मद्र्य॑ग् घुवानः॒ सो॒मपीतये । ह॒रिभ्यां याह्य् अद्रिवः ॥१॥
20.23.e: Invoked to drink the Soma juice come with thy bay steeds, Thunder-armed! Come, Indra, hitherward, to me.

20.23.d: सत्तो॒ हो॒ता न ऋत्वि॒यस् तिस्तिरे॒ बर्हि॒र् आनुष॒क् । अ॒युज्रन् प्रात॒र् अ॒द्रयः ॥२॥
20.23.e: Our priest is seated true to time; the grass is regularly strewn; The pressing-stones were set at morn.

20.23.d: इमा॒ ब्र॒ह्म ब्रह्मवाहः क्रिय॒न्त आ॒ बर्हिः॒ सीद । वीहि॒ शूर पुरोला॒शम् ॥३॥
20.23.e: These prayers, O thou who bearest prayer, are offered. Seat thee on the grass. Hero, enjoy the offered cake.

20.23.d: रारन्धि॒ स॒वनेषु ण एषु॒ स्तो॒मेषु वृत्रहन् । उक्थे॒ष्व् इन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥४॥
20.23.e: O Vritra-slayer, be thou pleased with these libations, with these hymns, Song-loving Indra, with our lauds.

20.23.d: मत॒यः सोमपा॒म् उरुं॒ रिह॒न्ति श॒वसस् प॒तिम् । इ॒न्द्रं वत्सं॒ न॒ मात॒रः ॥५॥
20.23.e: Our hymns caress the Lord of Strength, vast, drinker of the Soma's juice, Indra, as mother-cows their calf.

20.23.d: स॒ मन्दस्वा ह्य् अ॒न्धसो रा॒धसे तन्वा॑ महे॒ । न॒ स्तोता॒रं निदे॒ करः ॥६॥
20.23.e: Delight thee with the juice we pour for thine own great munificence: Yield not thy singer to reproach.

20.23.d: वय॒म् इन्द्र त्वाय॒वो हवि॒ष्मन्तो जरामहे । उत॒ त्व॒म् अस्मयु॒र् वसो ॥७॥
20.23.e: We, Indra, dearly loving thee, bearing oblation, sing thee hymns: Thou, Vasu, nearly lovest us.

20.23.d: मा॒रे॒ अस्म॒द् वि॒ मुमुचो ह॒रिप्रियार्वा॒ङ् याहि । इ॒न्द्र स्वधावो म॒त्स्वेह॒ ॥८॥
20.23.e: O thou to whom thy Bays are dear, loose not thy horses far from us: Here glad thee, Indra, Lord Divine.

20.23.d: अर्वा॒ञ्चं त्वा सुखे॒ र॒थे व॒हताम् इन्द्र केशि॒ना । घृत॒स्नू बर्हि॒र् आस॒दे ॥९॥
20.23.e: May long-maned courses, dropping oil, bring thee on swift car hitherward. Indra, to seat thee on the grass.

20.24.d: उ॒प नः सुत॒म् आ॒ गहि सो॒मम् इन्द्र ग॒वाशिरम् । ह॒रिभ्यां य॒स् ते अस्मयुः॒ ॥१॥
20.24.e: Come to the juice that we have pressed, to Soma, Indra! blent with milk: Come, favouring us, thy bay-drawn car!

20.24.d: त॒म् इन्द्र म॒दम् आ॒ गहि बर्हिष्ठां॒ ग्रा॒वभिः सुत॒म् । कुवि॒न् न्व् अ॑स्य तृप्ण॒वः ॥२॥
20.24.e: Come, Indra, to this gladdening drink, placed on the grass, pressed out with stones: Wilt thou not drink thy fill thereof?

20.24.d: इ॒न्द्रम् इत्था॒ गि॒रो म॒मा॒छागुर् इषिता॒ इतः॒ । आवृ॒ते सो॒मपीतये ॥३॥
20.24.e: To Indra have my songs of praise gone forth, thus rapidly sent hence, To turn him to the Soma-draught.

20.24.d: इ॒न्द्रं सो॒मस्य पीत॒ये स्तो॒मैर् इह॒ हवामहे । उक्थे॒भिः कुवि॒द् आग॒मत् ॥४॥
20.24.e: Hither with songs of praise we call Indra to drink the Soma. juice: Will he not come to us by lauds?

20.24.d: इ॒न्द्र सो॒माः सुता॒ इमे॒ ता॒न् दधिष्व शतक्रतो । जथ॒रे वाजिनीवसो ॥५॥
20.24.e: Indra, these Somas are expressed, Take them within thy belly, Lord Of Hundred Powers, thou Prince of wealth.

20.24.d: विद्मा॒ हि॒ त्वा धनंजयं॒ वा॒जेषु दधृषं॒ कवे । अ॒धा ते सुम्न॒म् ईमहे ॥६॥
20.24.e: We know thee winner of the spoil and resolute in battles, Sage! Therefore thy blessing we implore.

20.24.d: इम॒म् इन्द्र ग॒वाशिरं य॒वाशिरं च नः पिब । आग॒त्या वृ॒षभिः सुत॒म् ॥७॥
20.24.e: Borne hither by thy stallions, drink, Indra, this juice which we have pressed, Mingled with barley and with milk.

20.24.d: तु॒भ्ये॒द् इन्द्र स्व॒ ओक्ये॑ सो॒मं चोदामि पीत॒ये । एष॒ रारन्तु ते हृदि॒ ॥८॥
20.24.e: Indra, for thee in thine own place I urge the Soma for thy draught: Deep in thy heart let it remain.

20.24.d: त्वां॒ सुत॒स्य पीत॒ये प्रत्न॒म् इन्द्र हवामहे । कुशिका॒सो अवस्य॒वः ॥९॥
20.24.e: We call on thee, the Ancient One, Indra, to drink the Soma juice, We Kusikas who seek thine aid.

20.25.d: अ॒श्वावति प्रथमो॒ गो॒षु गछति सुप्रावी॒र् इन्द्र म॒र्त्यस् त॒वोति॒भिः । त॒म् इ॒त् पृणक्षि व॒सुना भ॒वीयसा सि॒न्धुम् आ॒पो य॒थाभि॒तो वि॒चेतसः ॥१॥
20.25.e: Indra, the mortal man well guarded by thine aid goes foremost in the wealth of horses and of kine. With amplest wealth thou fillest him, as round about the waters clearly seen afar fill Sindhu full.

20.25.d: आ॒पो न॒ देवी॒र् उ॒प यन्ति होत्रि॒यम् अवः॒ पश्यन्ति वि॒ततं य॒था र॒जः । प्राचै॒र् देवा॒सः प्र॒ णयन्ति देवयुं॒ ब्रह्मप्रि॒यं जोषयन्ते वरा॒ इव ॥२॥
20.25.e: The heavenly waters come not nigh the priestly bowl: they but look down and see how far mid-air is spread: The Deities conduct the pious man to them: like suitors they delight in him who loveth prayer.

20.25.d: अ॒धि द्व॒योर् अदधा उक्थ्यं॑ व॒चो यत॒स्रुचा मिथुना॒ या॒ सपर्य॒तः । अ॒संयत्तो व्रते॒ ते क्षेति पु॒ष्यति भद्रा॒ शक्ति॒र् य॒जमानाय सुन्वते॒ ॥३॥
20.25.e: Praiseworthy blessing hast thou laid upon the pair who with uplifted ladle serve thee, man and wife. Unchecked he dwells and prospers in thy law: thy power brings blessing to the sacrificer pouring gifts.

20.25.d: आ॒द् अ॒ङ्गिराः प्रथमं॒ दधिरे व॒य इद्धा॒ग्नयः श॒म्या ये॒ सुकृत्य॒या । स॒र्वं पणेः॒ स॒म् अविन्दन्त भो॒जनम् अ॒श्वावन्तं गो॒मन्तम् आ॒ पशुं॒ न॒रः ॥४॥
20.25.e: First the Angirases won themselves vital power, whose fires were kindled through good deeds and sacrifice. The men together found the Pani's hoarded wealth, the cattle, and the wealth in horses and in kine,

20.25.d: यज्ञै॒र् अ॒थर्वा प्रथमः॒ पथ॒स् तते त॒तः सू॒र्यो व्रतपा॒ वेन॒ आ॒जनि । आ॒ गा॒ आजद् उश॒ना काव्यः॒ स॒चा यम॒स्य जात॒म् अमृ॒तं यजामहे ॥५॥
20.25.e: Atharvan first by sacrifices laid the path; then, guardian of the Law, sprang up the loving Sun. Usanā Kāvya drove the kine hither with him: let us with offer- ings honour Yama's deathless birth.

20.25.d: बर्हि॒र् वा य॒त् स्वपत्या॒य वृज्य॒ते ऽर्को॒ वा श्लो॒कम् आघो॒षते दिवि॒ । ग्रा॒वा य॒त्र व॒दति करु॒र् उक्थ्य॑स् त॒स्ये॒द् इ॒न्द्रो अभिपित्वे॒षु रण्यति ॥६॥
20.25.e: When sacred grass is trimmed to aid the auspicious work, or the hymn makes its voice of praise sound to the sky, Where the stone rings as 'twere a singer skilled in laud,—Indra in truth delights when these come near to him.

20.25.d: प्रो॒ग्रां॒ पीतिं॒ वृ॒ष्ण इयर्मि सत्यां॒ प्रयै॒ सुत॒स्य हर्यश्व तु॒भ्यम् । इ॒न्द्र धे॒नाभिर् इह॒ मादयस्व धीभि॒र् वि॒श्वाभिः श॒च्या गृणानः॒ ॥७॥
20.25.e: To make thee start, a strong true draught I offer to thee the Bull, O thou whom bay steeds carry. Here take delight. O Indra, in our voices while thou art hymned with power and all our spirit.

20.26.d: यो॒गेयोगे तव॒स्तरं वा॒जेवाजे हवामहे । स॒खाय इ॒न्द्रम् ऊत॒ये ॥१॥
20.26.e: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends, to succour us Indra the mightiest of all.

20.26.d: आ॒ घा गमद् य॒दि श्र॒वत् सहस्रि॒णीभिर् ऊति॒भिः । वा॒जेभिर् उ॒प नो ह॒वम् ॥२॥
20.26.e: If he will hear us let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, And all that strengthens, to our call.

20.26.d: अ॒नु प्रत्न॒स्यौ॒कसो हुवे॒ तुविप्रतिं॒ न॒रम् । यं॒ ते पू॒र्वं पिता॒ हुवे॒ ॥३॥
20.26.e: I call him, mighty to resist, the Hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.

20.26.d: युञ्ज॒न्ति ब्रध्न॒म् अरुषं॒ च॒रन्तं प॒रि तस्थु॒षः । रो॒चन्ते रोचना॒ दिवि॒ ॥४॥
20.26.e: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy steed: The lights are shining in the sky.

20.26.d: युञ्ज॒न्ति अस्य का॒म्या ह॒री वि॒पक्षसा र॒थे । शो॒णा धृष्णू॒ नृवा॒हसा ॥५॥
20.26.e: On both sides of the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the thief.

20.26.d: केतुं॒ कृण्व॒न्न् अकेत॒वे पे॒शो मर्या अपेश॒से । स॒म् उष॒द्भिर् अजायथाः ॥६॥
20.26.e: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O Men! where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.

20.27.d: य॒द् इन्द्राहं॒ य॒था त्व॒म् ई॒शीय व॒स्व ए॒क इ॒त् । स्तोता॒ मे गो॒षखा स्यात् ॥१॥
20.27.e: If I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single sovran of all wealth. My worshipper should be rich in kine.

20.27.d: शि॒क्षेयम् अस्मै दि॒त्सेयं श॒चीपते मनीषि॒णे । य॒द् अहं॒ गो॒पतिः स्या॒म् ॥२॥
20.27.e: I should be fain, O Lord of Might, to strengthen and enrich the sage, Were I the lord of herds of kine,

20.27.d: धेनु॒ष् ट इन्द्र सूनृ॒ता य॒जमानाय सुन्वते॒ । गा॒म् अ॒श्वं पिप्यु॒षी दुहे ॥३॥
20.27.e: To worshippers who press the juice thy goodness, Indra, is a cow. Yielding in plenty kine and steeds.

20.27.d: न॒ ते वर्ता॒स्ति रा॒धस इ॒न्द्र देवो॒ न॒ म॒र्त्यः । य॒द् दि॒त्ससि स्तुतो॒ मघ॒म् ॥४॥
20.27.e: None is there, Indra, God or man, to hinder thy munificence, The wealth which, lauded, thou wilt give.

20.27.d: यज्ञ॒ इ॒न्द्रम् अवर्धयद् य॒द् भू॒मिं व्य् अ॑वर्तयत् । चक्राण॒ ओपशं॒ दिवि॒ ॥५॥
20.27.e: The sacrifice made Indra strong when he unrolled the earth and made Himself a diaden in heaven.

20.27.d: वावृधान॒स्य ते वयं॒ वि॒श्वा ध॒नानि जिग्यु॒षः । ऊति॒म् इन्द्रा॒ वृणीमहे ॥६॥
20.27.e: Thine aid we claim, O Indra, thine who after thou hast waxen great. Hast won all treasures for thine own.

20.28.d: व्य् अ॑न्त॒रिक्षम् अतिरन् म॒दे सो॒मस्य रोचना॒ । इ॒न्द्रो य॒द् अ॒भिनद् वल॒म् ॥१॥
20.28.e: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light. When he cleft Vala limb from limb.

20.28.d: उ॒द् गा॒ आजद् अ॒ङ्गिरोभ्य आवि॒ष् क्र्ण्व॒न् गु॒हा सतीः॒ । अर्वा॒ञ्चं नुनुदे वल॒म् ॥२॥
20.28.e: Showing the hidden he draye forth the cows for the Angirases, And Vala he cast headlong down.

20.28.d: इ॒न्द्रेण रोचना॒ दिवो॒ दृल्हा॒नि दृंहिता॒नि च । स्थिरा॒णि न॒ पराणु॒दे ॥३॥
20.28.e: By Indra were the luminous realms of heaven established and secured. Firm and immovable in their place.

20.28.d: अपा॒म् ऊर्मि॒र् म॒दन्न् इव स्तो॒म इन्द्राजिरायते । वि॒ ते म॒दा अराजिषुः ॥४॥
20.28.e: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of water-floods. Bright shine the drops that gladden thee.

20.29.d: त्वं॒ हि॒ स्तोमव॒र्धन इ॒न्द्रा॒स्य् उक्थव॒र्धनः । स्तोतृ̄णा॒म् उत॒ भद्रकृ॒त् ॥१॥
20.29.e: For thou, O Indra, art the God whom hymns and praises magnify: Thou blessest those who worship thee.

20.29.d: इ॒न्द्रम् इ॒त् केशि॒ना ह॒री सोमपे॒याय वक्षतः । उ॒प यज्ञं॒ सुरा॒धसम् ॥२॥
20.29.e: Bay horses with their long manes bring Indra to drink the Soma juice, The Bountiful to our sacrifice.

20.29.d: अपां॒ फे॒नेन न॒मुचेः शि॒र इन्द्रो॒द् अवर्तयः । वि॒श्वा य॒द् अ॒जय स्पृ॒धः ॥३॥
20.29.e: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuchi, Subduing all contending hosts.

20.29.d: माया॒भिर् उत्सि॒सृप्सत इन्द्र द्या॒म् आरु॒रुक्षतः । अ॒व द॒स्यूंर् अधूनुथाः ॥४॥
20.29.e: The Dasyus, when they fain would climb by magic arts and mount to heaven, Thou, Indra, castest down to earth.

20.29.d: असुन्वा॒म् इन्द्र संस॒दं वि॒षूचीं व्य् अ॑नाशयः । सोमपा॒ उ॒त्तरो भ॒वन् ॥५॥
20.29.e: As Soma-drinker conquering all, thou scatteredst to every side Their band who poured no gifts to thee.

20.30.d: प्र॒ ते महे॒ विद॒थे शंसिषं ह॒री प्र॒ ते वन्वे वनु॒षो हर्यतं॒ म॒दम् । घृतं॒ न॒ यो॒ ह॒रिभिश् चा॒रु से॒चत आ॒ त्वा विशन्तु ह॒रिवर्पसं गि॒रः ॥१॥
20.30.e: In the great synod will I laud thy two bay steeds: I prize the sweet strong drink of thee the Warrior-God, His who pours lovely oil as'twere with yellow drops. Let my songs enter thee whose form hath golden tints.

20.30.d: ह॒रिं हि॒ यो॒निम् अभि॒ ये॒ सम॒स्वरन् हिन्व॒न्तो ह॒री दिव्यं॒ य॒था स॒दः । आ॒ यं॒ पृण॒न्ति ह॒रिभिर् न॒ धेन॒व इ॒न्द्राय शूशं॒ ह॒रिवन्तम् अर्चत ॥२॥
20.30.e: Ye who—in concert sing unto the gold-hued place, like bay steeds driving onward to the heavenly seat, For Indra laud ye strength allied with tawny steeds, laud him whom cows content as'twere with yellow drops.

20.30.d: सो॒ अस्य व॒ज्रो ह॒रितो य॒ आयसो॒ ह॒रिर् नि॒कामो ह॒रिर् आ॒ ग॒भस्त्योः । द्युम्नी॒ सुशिप्रो॒ ह॒रिमन्युसायक इ॒न्द्रे नि॒ रूपा॒ ह॒रिता मिमिक्षिरे ॥३॥
20.30.e: His is that thunderbolt, of iron, golden-hued, gold-coloured, very dear, and yellow in his arms; Bright with strong teeth, destroying with its tawny rage. In Indra are set fast all forms of golden hue.

20.30.d: दिवि॒ न॒ केतु॒र् अ॒धि धायि हर्यतो॒ विव्य॒चद् व॒ज्रो ह॒रितो न॒ रं॒ह्या । तुद॒द् अहिं॒ ह॒रिशिप्रो य॒ आयसः॒ सह॒स्रशोका अभवद् धरिम्भरः॒ ॥४॥
20.30.e: As if a lovely ray were laid upon the sky, the golden thunder- bolt spread out as in a race. That iron bolt with yellow jaw smote Ahi down. A thousand flames had he who bore the tawny-hued.

20.30.d: त्वं॒त्वम् अहर्यथा उ॒पस्तुतः पू॒र्वेभिर् इन्द्र हरिकेश य॒ज्वभिः । त्वं॒ हर्यसि त॒व वि॒श्वम् उक्थ्य॑म् अ॒सामि रा॒धो हरिजात हर्यत॒म् ॥५॥
20.30.e: Thou, thou, when praised by men who sacrificed of old, hadst pleasure in their lauds, O Indra golden-haired. All that befits thy song of praise thou welcomest, the perfect: pleasant gift, O golden-hued from birth.

20.31.d: ता॒ वज्रि॒णं मन्दि॒नं स्तो॒म्यं म॒द इ॒न्द्रं र॒थे वहतो हर्यता ह॒री । पुरू॒ण्य् अस्मै स॒वनानि ह॒र्यत इ॒न्द्राय सो॒मा ह॒रयो दधन्विरे ॥१॥
20.31.e: These two dear Bays bring hither Indra on his car, thunder- armed, joyous, meet for laud, to drink his fill. Many libations flow for him who loveth them: to Indra have: the gold-hued Soma juices run.

20.31.d: अ॒रं का॒माय ह॒रयो दधमिरे स्थिरा॒य हिन्वन् ह॒रयो ह॒री तुरा॒ । अ॒र्वद्भिर् यो॒ ह॒रिभिर् जो॒षम् ई॒यते सो॒ अस्य का॒मं ह॒रिवन्तम् आनशे ॥२॥
20.31.e: The gold-hued drops have flowed to gratify his wish: the yellow. drops have urged the swift Bays to the Strong. He who speeds on with bay steeds even as he lists hath satisfied his longing for the golden drops.

20.31.d: ह॒रिश्मशारुर् ह॒रिकेश आयस॒स् तुरस्पे॒ये यो॒ हरिपा॒ अ॒वर्धत । अ॒र्वद्भिर् यो॒ ह॒रिभिर् वाजि॒नीवसुर् अ॒ति वि॒श्वा दुरिता॒ पा॒रिषद् ध॒री ॥३॥
20.31.e: At the swift draught the Soma-drinker waxed in might, the iron. One with yellow beard and golden hair, He, Lord of tawny coursers. Lord of fleet-foot mares, will bear his bay steeds safely over all distress.

20.31.d: श्रु॒वेव यस्य ह॒रिणी विपेत॒तुः शि॒प्रे वा॒जाय ह॒रिणी द॒विध्वतः । प्र॒ य॒त् कृते॒ चमसे॒ म॒र्मृजद् ध॒री पीत्वा॒ म॒दस्य हर्यत॒स्या॒न्धसः ॥४॥
20.31.e: His yellow-coloured jaws, like ladles, move apart, what time,. for strength, he makes the yellow-tinted stir, When. while the bowl stands there, he grooms his tawny steeds, when he hath drunk strong drink, the sweet juice that he: loves.

20.31.d: उत॒ स्म स॒द्न हर्यत॒स्य पस्त्यो॑र् अ॒त्यो न॒ वा॒जं ह॒रिवां अचिक्रदत् । मही॒ चिद् धि॒ धिष॒णा॒हर्यद् ओ॒जसा बृह॒द् व॒यो दधिषे हर्यत॒स् चिद् आ॒ ॥५॥
20.31.e: Yea, to the dear one's seat in homes of heaven and earth the- bay steeds' Lord hath whinnied like a horse for food. Then the great wish hath seized upon him mightily, and the beloved One hath gained high power of life.

20.32.d: आ॒ रो॒दसी ह॒र्यमाणो महित्वा॒ न॒व्यंनव्यं हर्यसि म॒न्म नु॒ प्रिय॒म् । प्र॒ पस्त्य॑म् असुर हर्यतं॒ गो॒र् आवि॒ष् कृधि ह॒रये सू॒र्याय ॥१॥
20.32.e: Thou, comprehending with thy might the earth and heaven, acceptest the dear hymn for ever new and new. O Asura, disclose thou and make visible the Cow's beloved home to the bright golden Sun.

20.32.d: आ॒ त्वा हर्य॒न्तं प्रयु॒जो ज॒नानां र॒थे वहन्तु ह॒रिशिप्रम् इन्द्र । पि॒बा य॒था प्र॒तिभृतस्य म॒ध्वो ह॒र्यन् यज्ञं॒ सधमा॒दे द॒शोणिम् ॥२॥
20.32.e: O Indra, let the eager wishes of the folk bring thee the golden- jawed, delightful, on thy car. That, pleased with sacrifice wherein ten fingers toil, thou mayest at the feast drink of our offered mead.

20.32.d: अ॒पाः पू॒र्वेषां हरिवः सुता॒नाम् अ॒थो इदं॒ स॒वनं के॒वलं ते । ममद्धि॒ सो॒मं म॒धुमन्तम् इन्द्र सत्रा॒ वृषं जथ॒र आ॒ वृषस्व ॥३॥
20.32.e: Juices aforetime, Lord of Bays, thou drankest, and thine, and only thine, is this libation. Gladden thee, Indra, with the mead-rich Soma: pour it down ever, Mighty One, within thee.

20.33.d: अप्सु॒ धूत॒स्य हरिवः पि॒बेह॒ नृ॒भिः सुत॒स्य जठ॒रं पृणस्व । मिमिक्षु॒र् य॒म् अ॒द्रय इन्द्र तु॒भ्यं ते॒भिर् वर्धस्व म॒दम् उक्थवाहः ॥१॥
20.33.e: Drink of the juice which men have washed in waters and fill the- full, O Lord of tawny horses. O Indra, hearer of the laud, with Soma which stones have mix- ed for thee enhance thy rapture.

20.33.d: प्रो॒ग्रां॒ पीतिं॒ वृ॒ष्ण इयर्मि सत्यां॒ प्रयै॒ सुत॒स्य हर्यश्व तु॒भ्यम् । इ॒न्द्र धे॒नाभिर् इह॒ मादयस्व धीभि॒र् वि॒श्वाभिः श॒च्या गृणानः॒ ॥२॥
20.33.e: To make thee start, a strong true draught I offer to thee the Bull, O thou whom bay steeds carry. Here take delight, O Indra, in our voices while thou art hymned with power and all our spirit.

20.33.d: ऊती॒ शचीवस् त॒व वीर्ये॑ण व॒यो द॒धाना उशि॒ज ऋतज्ञाः॒ । प्रजा॒वद् इन्द्र मं॒सो दुरोणे॒ तस्थु॒र् गृण॒न्तः सधमा॒द्यासः ॥३॥
20.33.e: O mighty Indra, through thine aid, thy prowess, obtaining life, zealous, and skilled in worship. Men in the house who share the sacred banquet stand singing praise that brings them store of children.

20.34.d: यो॒ जात॒ एव॒ प्रथमो॒ म॒नस्वान् देवो॒ देवा॒न् क्र॒तुना पर्य॒मूषत् । य॒स्य शु॒ष्माद् रो॒दसी अ॒भ्यसेतां नृम्ण॒स्य मह्ना॒ स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥१॥
20.34.e: He who just born, chief God of lofty spirit, by power and might became the God's protector, Before whose breath, through greatness of his valour, the two worlds trembled, He, O men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यः॒ पृथिवीं॒ व्य॒थमानाम् अ॒दृंहद् यः॒ प॒र्वतान् प्र॒कुपितां अ॒रम्णात् । यो॒ अन्त॒रिक्षं विममे॒ व॒रीयो यो॒ द्याम् अ॒स्तभ्नात् स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥२॥
20.34.e: He who fixed fast and firm the earth that staggered, and set at rest the agitated mountains, Who measured out air's wider middle region and gave the heaven support, He, O men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यो॒ हत्वा॒हिम् अ॒रिणात् सप्त॒ सि॒न्धून् यो॒ गा॒ उदा॒जद् अपधा॒ वल॒स्य । यो॒ अ॒श्मनोर् अन्त॒र् अग्निं॒ जजान संवृ॒क् सम॒त्सु स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥३॥
20.34.e: Who slew the Dragon, freed the Seven Rivers, and draye the kine forth from the cave of Vala, Begat the fire between both stones, the spoiler in warrior's battle, He, O men, is Indra.

20.34.d: ये॒नेमा॒ वि॒श्वा च्य॒वना कृता॒नि यो॒ दा॒सं व॒र्णम् अ॒धरं गु॒हा॒कः । श्वघ्नी॒व यो॒ जिगीवां॒ लक्ष॒म् आ॒दद् अर्यः॒ पुष्टा॒नि स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥४॥
20.34.e: By whom this universe was made to tremble, who chased away the humbled brood of demon, Who, like a gambler gathering his winnings, seized the foe's riches, He, O men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यं॒ स्मा पृछ॒न्ति कु॒ह से॒ति घोर॒म् उते॒म् आहुर् नै॒षो॒ अस्ती॒त्य् एनम् । सो॒ अर्यः॒ पुष्टी॒र् वि॒ज इवा॒ मिनाति श्र॒द् अस्मै धत्त स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥५॥
20.34.e: Of whom, the terrible, they ask, Where is He? or verily they say of him, He is not. He wastes the foeman's wealth like stakes of gamblers. Have faith in him for He, O men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यो॒ रध्र॒स्य चोदिता॒ यः॒ कृश॒स्य यो॒ ब्रह्म॒णो ना॒धमानस्य कीरेः॒ । युक्त॒ग्राव्णो यो॒ ऽविता॒ सुशिप्रः॒ सुत॒सोमस्य स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥६॥
20.34.e: Stirrer to action of the poor and lowly, of priest, of suppliant who sings his praises Who, fair-faced, favours him who presseth Soma with stones adjusted, He, O men, is Indra.

20.34.d: य॒स्या॒श्वासः प्रदि॒शि य॒स्य गा॒वो य॒स्य ग्रा॒मा य॒स्य वि॒श्वे र॒थासः । यः॒ सू॒र्यं य॒ उष॒सं जजा॒न यो॒ अपां॒ नेता॒ स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥७॥
20.34.e: He under whose supreme control are horses, all chariots, and the hamlets, and the cattle: He who begat the Sun, begat the Morning, leader of waters. He, O men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यं॒ क्र॒न्दसी संयती॒ विह्व॒येते प॒रे॒ ऽवरे उभ॒या अमि॒त्राः । समानं॒ चिद् र॒थम् आतस्थिवां॒सा ना॒ना हवेते स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥८॥
20.34.e: To whom both armies cry in close encounter, foe against foe, the stronger and the weaker; Whom two invoke upon one chariot mounted, each for himself, He, O ye men, is Indra.

20.34.d: य॒स्मान् न॒ ऋते॒ विज॒यन्ते ज॒नासो यं॒ यु॒ध्यमाना अ॒वसे ह॒वन्ते । यो॒ वि॒श्वस्य प्रतिमा॒नं बभू॒व यो॒ अच्युतच्यु॒त् स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥९॥
20.34.e: He, without whom men conquer not in battle, whom, warring, they invoke for help and succour; He, all this universe's type and image, who shakes what never shook, He, men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यः॒ श॒स्वतो म॒ह्य् एनो द॒धानान् अ॒मन्यमानां छ॒र्वा जघा॒न । यः॒ श॒र्धते ना॒नुद॒दाति शृध्यां॒ यो॒ द॒स्योर् हन्ता॒ स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥१०॥
20.34.e: He who hath smitten, ere they know their danger, with his hurl- ed weapon many grievous sinners: Who pardons not his boldness who provokes him, who slays the Dasyu, He, O men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यः॒ श॒म्भरं प॒र्वतेषु क्षिय॒न्तं चत्वारिंश्यां॒ शर॒द्य् अन्व॒विन्दत् । ओजाय॒मानं यो॒ अ॒हिं जघा॒न दा॒नुं श॒यानं स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥११॥
20.34.e: He who discovered in the fortieth autumn Sambara dwelling in the midst of mountains: Who slew the Dragon putting forth his vigour, the demon lying there, He, men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यः॒ शम्भरं पर्य॒तरत् क॒सीभिर् यो॒ ऽचारुकास्ना॒पिबत् सुत॒स्य । अन्त॒र् गिरौ॒ य॒जमानं बहुं॒ ज॒नं य॒स्मिन्न् आ॒मूर्छत् स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥१२॥
20.34.e: Who drank the juice poured at the seas of Order, subduing Sambara by superior prowess, Who hoarded food within the mountain's hollow wherein he grew in strength, He, men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यः॒ सप्त॒रश्मिर् वृषभ॒स् तु॒विष्मान् अवा॒सृजत् स॒र्तवे सप्त॒ सि॒न्धून् । यो॒ रौहिण॒म् अ॒स्फुरद् व॒ज्रबाहुर् द्या॒म् आरो॒हन्तं स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥१३॥
20.34.e: Who, with seven guiding reins, the Bull, the mighty, set the Seven Rivers free to flow at pleasure; Who, thunder-armed, rent Rauhina in pieces when scaling heaven, He, O ye men, is Indra.

20.34.d: द्या॒वा चिद् अस्मै पृथिवी॒ ममेते शु॒ष्माच् चिद् अस्य प॒र्वता भयन्ते । यः॒ सोमपा॒ निचितो॒ व॒ज्रबाहुर् यो॒ व॒ज्रहस्तः स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥१४॥
20.34.e: Heaven, even, and the earth bow down before him, before his very breath the mountains tremble. Known as the Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, the wielder of the bolt, He, men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यः॒ सुन्व॒न्तम् अ॒वति यः॒ प॒चन्तं यः॒ शं॒सन्तं यः॒ शशमान॒म् ऊती॒ । य॒स्य ब्र॒ह्म व॒र्धनं य॒स्य सो॒मो य॒स्येदं॒ रा॒धः स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥१५॥
20.34.e: Who aids with favour him who pours the Soma, and him who brews it, sacrificer, singer; Whose strength our prayer and offered Soma heighten, and this our gift, He, O ye men, is Indra.

20.34.d: जातो॒ व्य् अ॑ख्यत् पित्रो॒र् उप॒स्थे भु॒वो न॒ वेद जनितुः॒ प॒रस्य । स्तविष्य॒माणो नो॒ यो॒ अस्म॒द् व्रता॒ देवा॒नां स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥१६॥
20.34.e: Born, manifested in his Parents' bosom, He knoweth as a son the Highest Father. He who with vigorous energy assisted the companies of Gods, He, men, is Indra

20.34.d: यः॒ सो॒मकामो ह॒र्यश्वः सूरि॒र् य॒स्माद् रे॒जन्ते भु॒वनानि वि॒श्वा । यो॒ जघा॒न श॒म्बरं य॒श् च शु॒ष्णं य॒ एकवीरः॒ स॒ जनास इ॒न्द्रः ॥१७॥
20.34.e: Lord of Bay steeds, who loves the flowing Soma, He before whom all living creatures tremble. He who smote Sambara and slaughtered Sushna, He the Sole Hero, He, O men, is Indra.

20.34.d: यः॒ सुन्वते॒ प॒चते दुध्र॒ आ॒ चिद् वा॒जं द॒र्दर्षि स॒ कि॒लासि सत्यः॒ । वयं॒ त इन्द्र विश्व॒ह प्रिया॒सः सुवी॒रासो विद॒थम् आ॒ वदेम ॥१८॥
20.34.e: Thou verily art true strong God who sendest wealth to the man who brews and pours libation. So may we evermore, thy friends, O Indra, address the synod with brave sons about us.

20.35.d: अस्मा॒ इ॒द् उ प्र॒ तव॒से तुरा॒य प्र॒यो न॒ हर्मि स्तो॒मं मा॒हिनाय । ऋ॒चीषमाया॒ध्रिगव ओ॒हम् इ॒न्द्राय ब्र॒ह्माणि रात॒तमा ॥१॥
20.35.e: To him, to him swift, strong, and high-exalted, I bring my song of praise as dainty viands; My thought to him resistless, meet for praises, prayers offered most devotedly to Indra.

20.35.d: अस्मा॒ इ॒द् उ प्र॒य इव प्र॒ यंसि भ॒राम्य् आन्गूषं॒ बा॒धे सुवृक्ति॒ । इ॒न्द्राय हृदा॒ म॒नसा मनीषा॒ प्रत्ना॒य प॒त्ये धि॒यो मर्जयन्त ॥२॥
20.35.e: To him I offer praise as choice refreshment, bring forth my song, with seemly laud besiege him. For Indra, Lord of olden time, the singers shall deck their hymns with heart and mind and spirit.

20.35.d: अस्मा॒ इ॒द् उ त्य॒म् उपमं॒ स्वर्षां॒ भ॒राम्य् आङ्गूष॒म् आस्ये॑न । मं॒हिष्ठम् अ॒छोक्तिभिर् मतीनां॒ सुवृक्ति॒भिः सूरिं॒ वावृध॒ध्यै ॥३॥
20.35.e: To him then with my lips my song of praises, excellent, winning heavenly light, I offer, To magnify with hymns of invocation and eulogies the Lord, most bounteous Giver.

20.35.d: अस्मा॒ इ॒द् उ स्तो॒मं सं॒ हिनोमि र॒थं न॒ त॒ष्टेव त॒त्सिनाय । गि॒रश् च गि॒र्वाहसे सुवृक्ती॒न्द्राय विश्वमिन्वं॒ मे॒धिराय ॥४॥
20.35.e: Even for him I frame a laud—so fashions the wright a chariot for the man who needs it Songs for wise Indra hymned with invocation, a song composed with care and all-impelling.

20.35.d: अस्मा॒ इ॒द् उ स॒प्तिम् इव श्रवस्ये॒न्द्रायार्कं॒ जुह्वा॑ स॒म् अञ्जे । वीर॒म् दानौ॒कसं वन्द॒ध्यै पुरां॒ गूर्त॒श्रवसं दर्मा॒णम् ॥५॥
20.35.e: So with my tongue I deck, to please that Indra, my hymn as't- were a horse, through love of glory, To reverence the Hero, bounteous Giver, famed far and wide, destroyer of the castles.

20.35.d: अस्मा॒ इ॒द् उ त्व॒ष्टा तक्षद् व॒ज्रं स्व॒पस्तमं स्वर्यं॑ र॒णाय । वृत्र॒स्य चिद् विद॒द् ये॒न म॒र्म तुज॒न्न् ई॒शानस् तुजता॒ कियेधाः॒ ॥६॥
20.35.e: Even for him hath Tvashtar forged the thunder, most deftly wrought, celestial, for the battle. Wherewith he reached the vital parts of Vritra, striking—the vast, the mighty—with the striker,

20.35.d: अस्ये॒द् उ मातुः॒ स॒वनेषु सद्यो॒ महः॒ पितुं॒ पपिवां॒ चा॒र्व् अ॒न्ना । मुषाय॒द् वि॒ष्णुः पचतं॒ स॒हीयान् वि॒ध्यद् वराहं॒ तिरो॒ अ॒द्रिम् अ॒स्ता ॥७॥
20.35.e: As soon as, at libations of his mother, great Vishnu had drunk up the draught, he plundered. The dainty cates, the cooked mess; but One stronger transfixed the wild boar, shooting through the mountain.

20.35.d: अस्मा॒ इ॒द् उ ग्ना॒श् चिद् देव॒पत्नीर् इ॒न्द्रायार्क॒म् अहिह॒त्य ऊवुः । प॒रि द्या॒वापृथिवी॒ जभ्र उर्वी॒ ना॒स्य ते॒ महिमा॒नं प॒रि ष्टः ॥८॥
20.35.e: To him, to Indra when he slew the Dragon, the Dames too, Consorts of the Gods, wove praises. The mighty heaven and earth hath he encompassed: thy great- ness heaven and earth, combined, exceed not.

20.35.d: अस्ये॒द् एव॒ प्र॒ रिरिचे महित्वं॒ दिव॒स् पृथिव्याः॒ प॒र्य् अन्त॒रिक्षात् । स्वरा॒ल् इ॒न्द्रो द॒म आ॒ विश्व॒गूर्तः स्वरि॒र् अ॒मत्रो ववक्षे र॒णाय ॥९॥
20.35.e: Yea, of a truth, his magnitude surpasseth the magnitude of earth, mid-air and heaven. Indra whom all men praise, the Sovran Ruler, waxed in his home loud-voiced and strong for battle.

20.35.d: अस्ये॒द् एव॒ श॒वसा शुश॒न्तं वि॒ वृश्चद् व॒ज्रेण वृत्र॒म् इ॒न्द्रः । गा॒ न॒ व्राणा॒ अव॒नीर् अमुञ्चद् अभि॒ श्र॒वो दाव॒ने स॒चेताः ॥१०॥
20.35.e: Through his own strength with bolt of thunder Indra smote piece-meal Vritra, drier up of waters. He let the floods go free, like cows imprisoned, for glory, with a heart inclined to bounty.

20.35.d: अस्ये॒द् उ त्वेष॒सा रन्त सि॒न्धवः प॒रि य॒द् व॒ज्रेण सीम् अ॒यछत् । ईशानकृ॒द् दाशु॒षे दशस्य॒न् तुर्वी॒तये गाधं॒ तुर्व॒णिः कः॒ ॥११॥
20.35.e: Through his resplendent power still stood the rivers when with his bolt on every side he stayed them. With lordly might favouring him who worshipped, he made a ford, victorious, for Turviti.

20.35.d: अस्मा॒ इ॒द् उ प्र॒ भरा तू॒तुजानो वृत्रा॒य व॒ज्रम् ई॒शानः कियेधाः॒ । गो॒र् न॒ प॒र्व वि॒ रदा तिरश्चे॒ष्यन्न् अ॒र्णांस्य् अपां॒ चर॒ध्यै ॥१२॥
20.35.e: Vast, with thine ample power, with eager movement against this Vritra cast thy bolt of thunder. Rend thou his joints, as of an ox dissevered, with bolt oblique that floods of rain may follow.

20.35.d: अस्ये॒द् उ प्र॒ ब्रूहि पूर्व्या॒णि तुर॒स्य क॒र्माणि न॒व्य उक्थैः॒ । युधे॒ य॒द् इष्णान॒ आ॒युधान्य् ऋघाय॒माणो निरिणा॒ति श॒त्रून् ॥१३॥
20.35.e: Sing with new lauds his exploits wrought aforetime, the deeds of him, yea, him who moveth swiftly, When, hurling forth his weapons in the battle, he with impetuous wrath lays low the foemen.

20.35.d: अस्ये॒द् उ भिया॒ गिर॒यश् च दृल्हा॒ द्या॒वा च भू॒मा जनु॒षस् तुजेते । उ॒पो वेन॒स्य जो॒गुवान ओणिं॒ सद्यो॒ भुवद् वीर्या॑य नोधाः॒ ॥१४॥
20.35.e: When he, yea, he is born the firm-set mountains and the whole heaven and earth tremble in terror. May Nodhas ever lauding the protection of this dear Friend win straightway strength heroic.

20.35.d: अस्मा॒ इ॒द् उ त्य॒द् अ॒नु दाय्य् एषाम् ए॒को य॒द् वव्ने॒ भू॒रेर् ई॒शानः । प्रै॒तशं सू॒र्ये पस्पृधानं॒ सौ॒वश्व्ये सु॒ष्विम् आवद् इ॒न्द्रः ॥१५॥
20.35.e: Now unto him of these things hath been given what he, who rules alone o'er much, electeth. Indra helped Etasa, the Soma presser, contending in the chariot- race with Sūrya.

20.35.d: एवा॒ ते हारियोजना सुवृक्ती॒न्द्र ब्र॒ह्माणि गो॒तमासो अक्रन् । ऐ॒षु विश्व॒पेशसं धि॒यं धाः प्रात॒र् मक्षू॒ धिया॒वसुर् जगम्यात् ॥१६॥
20.35.e: Thus to thee, Indra, yoker of bay coursers, the Gotamas have brought their prayers and praises. Bestow upon them thought, decked with all beauty. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

20.36.d: य॒ ए॒क इ॒द् ध॒व्यश् चर्षणीना॒म् इ॒न्द्रं तं॒ गीर्भि॒र् अभ्य् अ॑र्च आभिः॒ । यः॒ प॒त्यते वृषभो॒ वृ॒ष्ण्यावान्त् सत्यः॒ स॒त्वा पुरुमायः॒ स॒हस्वान् ॥१॥
20.36.e: With these my hymns I glorify that Indra who is alone to be invoked by mortals. The Lord, the Mighty One, of manly vigour, victorious, Hero, true, and full of wisdom.

20.36.d: त॒म् उ नः पू॒र्वे पित॒रो न॒वग्वाः सप्त॒ वि॒प्रासो अभि॒ वाज॒यन्तः । नक्षद्दाभं॒ त॒तुरिं पर्वतेष्ठा॒म् अ॒द्रोघवाचं मति॒भिः श॒विष्ठम् ॥२॥
20.36.e: Our ancient sires, Navagvas, sages seven, while urging him to show his might, extolled him, Dweller on heights, swift smiting down opponents, guileless in word, and in his thoughts most mighty.

20.36.d: त॒म् ईमहे इ॒न्द्रम् अस्य रायः॒ पुरुवी॒रस्य नृव॒तः पुरुक्षोः॒ । यो॒ अ॒ष्कृधोयुर् अज॒रः स्व॑र्वान् त॒म् आ॒ भर हरिवो मादय॒ध्यै ॥३॥
20.36.e: We seek that Indra to obtain his riches that yield much food, and men, and store of heroes. O Lord of Bay Steeds, bring to make us joyful, celestial wealth abundant, undecaying.

20.36.d: त॒न् नो वि॒ वोचो य॒दि ते पुरा॒ चिज् जरिता॒र आनशुः॒ सुम्न॒म् इन्द्र । क॒स् ते भागः॒ किं॒ व॒यो दुध्र खिदुः पु॒रुहूत पुरूवसो ऽसुरघ्नः॒ ॥४॥
20.36.e: Declare to us—if at thy hand aforetime the earlier singers have obtained good fortune What is thy share and portion, strong Subduer, Asura-slayer, rich, invoked of many?

20.36.d: तं॒ पृछ॒न्ती व॒ज्रहस्तं रथेष्ठा॒म् इ॒न्द्रं वे॒पी व॒क्वरी य॒स्य नू॒ गीः॒ । तुविग्राभं॒ तुविकूर्मिं॒ रभोदां॒ गातु॒म् इ॒षे न॒क्षते तु॒म्रम् अ॒छ ॥५॥
20.36.e: He who for car-borne, thunder-wielding Indra, hath a hymn, craving deeply-piercing, fluent, Who sends a song effectual, firmly-grasping, and strength- bestowing, he comes near the mighty.

20.36.d: अया॒ ह त्यं॒ माय॒या वावृधानं॒ मनोजु॒वा स्वतवः प॒र्वतेन । अ॒च्युता चिद् वीलिता॒ स्वोजो रुजो॒ वि॒ दृल्हा॒ धृषता॒ विरप्शिन् ॥६॥
20.36.e: Strong of thyself! thou with this art hast shattered with thought- swift Parvata, him who waxed against thee; And, Mightiest! rager! boldly rent in pieces things that were firmly fixed and never shaken..

20.36.d: त॒म् वो धिया॒ न॒व्यस्या श॒विष्ठम् प्रत्नं॒ प्रत्नव॒त् परितंसय॒ध्यै । स॒ नो वक्षद् अनिमानः॒ सुव॒ह्ने॒न्द्रो वि॒श्वान्य् अ॒ति दुर्ग॒हाणि ॥७॥
20.36.e: Him will we fit for you with new devotion, the strongest, Ancient One, in ancient manner. So way that Indra, boundless, faithful leader, conduct us o'er all places hard to traverse.

20.36.d: आ॒ ज॒नाय द्रु॒ह्वणे पा॒र्थिवानि दिव्या॒नि दीपयो ऽन्त॒रिक्षा । त॒पा वृषन् विश्व॒तः शोचि॒षा ता॒न् ब्रह्मद्वि॒षे शो॒चय क्षा॒म् अप॒श् च ॥८॥
20.36.e: Thou for the people who oppress hast kindled the earthly firma- ment and that of heaven. With heat, O Bull, on every side consume them heat earth and flood for him who hates devotion:

20.36.d: भु॒वो ज॒नस्य दिव्य॒स्य रा॒जा पा॒र्थिवस्य ज॒गतस् त्वेषसंदृक् । धिष्व॒ व॒ज्रं द॒क्षिण इन्द्र ह॒स्ते वि॒श्वा अजुर्य दयसे वि॒ मायाः॒ ॥९॥
20.36.e: Of all the heavenly folk, of earthly creatures, thou art the King, O God of splendid aspect. In thy right hand, O Indra, grasp the thunder: Eternal! thou destroyest all enchantments.

20.36.d: आ॒ संय॒तम् इन्द्र णः स्वस्तिं॒ शत्रुतू॒र्याय बृहती॒म् अ॒मृध्राम् । य॒या दा॒सान्य् आ॒र्याणि वृत्रा॒ क॒रो वज्रिन्त् सुतु॒का ना॒हुषाणि ॥१०॥
20.36.e: Give us confirmed prosperity, O Indra, vast and exhaustless for the foes' subduing. Strengthen therewith the Arya's hate and Dāsa's; and let the arms of Nahushas be mighty.

20.36.d: स॒ नो नियु॒द्भिः पुरुहूत वेधो विश्व॒वाराभिर् आ॒ गहि प्रयज्यो । न॒ या॒ अ॒देवो व॒रते न॒ देव॒ आ॒भिर् याहि तू॒यम् आ॒ मद्र्यद्रि॒क् ॥११॥
20.36.e: Come with thy teams which bring all blessings, hither, disposer, much-invoked, exceeding holy! Come to me swiftly with these teams of coursers, these which no fiend, no God may stay or hinder.

20.37.d: य॒स् तिग्म॒शृङ्गो वृषभो॒ न॒ भीमः॒ ए॒कः कृष्टी॒श् च्यव॒यति प्र॒ वि॒श्वाः । यः॒ श॒श्वतो अ॒दाशुषो ग॒यस्य प्रयन्ता॒सि सु॒ष्वितराय वे॒दः ॥१॥
20.37.e: He, like a bull with sharpened horns, terrific, singly excites and agitates all the people. Then givest him who largely pours libation his wealth who pours not, for his own possession.

20.37.d: त्वं॒ ह त्य॒द् इन्द्र कु॒त्सम् आवः शुश्रूषमाणस् तन्वा॑ समर्ये॒ । दा॒सं य॒च् शु॒ष्णम् कु॒यवं न्य् अ॑स्मा अ॒रन्धय आर्जुनेया॒य शि॒क्षन् ॥२॥
20.37.e: Thou verily, Indra, gavest help to Kutsa, willingly lending ear to him in battle. When, aiding Arjunneya, thou subduedst to him both Kuyava and the Dāsa Sushna.

20.37.d: त्वं॒ धृष्णो धृषता॒ वीत॒हव्यं प्रा॒वो वि॒श्वाभिर् ऊति॒भिः सुदा॒सम् । प्र॒ पौ॒रुकुत्सिं त्रस॒दस्युम् आवः क्षे॒त्रसाता वृत्रह॒त्येषु पूरु॒म् ॥३॥
20.37.e: O Bold One, thou with all thine aids hast boldly helped Sudās whose offerings were accepted, Pūru in winning land and slaying foemen, and Trasadasyu son of Purukutsa.

20.37.d: त्वं॒ नृ॒भिर् नृमणो देव॒वीतौ भू॒रीणि वृत्रा॒ हर्यश्व हंसि । त्वं॒ नि॒ द॒स्युं चु॒मुरिं धु॒निं चा॒स्वापयो दभी॒तये सुह॒न्तु ॥४॥
20.37.e: At the Gods' banquet, Hero-souled! with heroes, Lord of Bay Steeds, thou slewest many Vritras. Thou sentest in swift death to sleep the Dasyu, both Chumuri and Dhuni, for Dabhiti,

20.37.d: त॒व च्यौत्ना॒नि वज्रहस्त ता॒नि न॒व य॒त् पु॒रो नवतिं॒ च सद्यः॒ । निवे॒शने शततमा॒विवेषीर् अ॒हं च वृत्रं॒ न॒मुचिम् उता॒हन् ॥५॥
20.37.e: These were thy mighty powers that, Thunder-wielder! then swiftly crushedst nine-and ninety castles. Thou capturedst the hundredth in thine onslaught; thou slewest Namuchi, thou slewest Vritra.

20.37.d: स॒ना ता॒ त इन्द्र भो॒जनानि रात॒हव्याय दाशु॒षे सुदा॒से । वृ॒ष्णे ते ह॒री वृ॒षणा युनज्मि व्य॒न्तु ब्र॒ह्माणि पुरुशाक वा॒जम् ॥६॥
20.37.e: Old are the blessings, Indra, which thou gavest Sudās the wor- shipperwho brought oblations. For thee, the strong I yoke thy strong bay horses: let them, approach our prayers and wealth, Most Mighty!

20.37.d: मा॒ ते अस्यां॒ सहसावन् प॒रिष्टाव् अघा॒य भूम हरिवः परादौ॒ । त्रा॒यस्व नो ऽवृके॒भिर् व॒रूथैस् त॒व प्रिया॒सः सूरि॒षु स्याम ॥७॥
20.37.e: Give us not up, Lord of Bay Horses, victor, in this our time of- trouble, to the wicked. Deliver us with true and faithful succour: dear may we be to thee among the princes.

20.37.d: प्रिया॒स इ॒त् ते मघवन्न् अभि॒ष्टौ न॒रो मदेम शरणे॒ स॒खायः । नि॒ तुर्व॒शं नि॒ या॒द्वं शिशीह्य् अतिथिग्वा॒य शं॒स्यं करिष्य॒न् ॥८॥
20.37.e: May we men, Bounteous Lord, the friends thou lovest, near i thee be joyful under thy protection. Fain to fulfil the wish of Atithigva, bow Turvasa, bow down,. the son of Yadu.

20.37.d: सद्य॒श् चिन् नु॒ ते मघवन्न् अभि॒ष्टौ न॒रः शंसन्त्य् उक्थशा॒स उक्था॒ । ये॒ ते ह॒वेभिर् वि॒ पणीं॒र् अ॒दाशन्न् अस्मा॒न् वृणीष्व यु॒ज्याय त॒स्मै ॥९॥
20.37.e: Swiftly, in truth, O Bounteous Lord, about thee men skilled im hymning sing their songs and praises. Elect us shares of their love and friendship who by their calls on, thee despoiled the niggards.

20.37.d: एते॒ स्तो॒मा नरां॒ नृतम तु॒भ्यम् अस्मद्र्य॑ञ्चो द॒दतो मघा॒नि । ते॒षाम् इन्द्र वृत्रह॒त्ये शिवो॒ भूः स॒खा च शू॒रो ऽविता॒ च नृणा॒म् ॥१०॥
20.37.e: Thine are these Lauds, O manliest of heroes, Lauds which revert to us and give us riches. Favour these, Indra, when they strike the foemen, as Friend and Hero and the heroes' helper.

20.37.d: नू॒ इन्द्र शूर स्त॒वमान ऊती॒ ब्र॒ह्मजूतस् तन्वा॑ वावृधस्व । उ॒प नो वा॒जान् मिमीह्य् उ॒प स्ती॒न् युयं॒ पात स्वस्ति॒भिः स॒दा नः ॥११॥
20.37.e: Now, lauded for thine aid, heroic Indra, sped by our prayer,, wax mighty in thy body. To us apportion wealth and habitations. Ye Gods, protect us- evermore with blessings.

20.38.d: आ॒ याहि सुषुमा॒ हि॒ त इ॒न्द्र सो॒मं पि॒बा इम॒म् । ए॒दं॒ बर्हिः॒ सदो म॒म ॥१॥
20.38.e: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee. O Indra, drink the Soma here. Sit thou on this my sacred grass.

20.38.d: आ॒ त्वा ब्रह्मयु॒जा ह॒री व॒हताम् इन्द्र केशि॒ना । उ॒प ब्र॒ह्माणि नः शृणु ॥२॥
20.38.e: O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward. Give ear and listen to our prayers.

20.38.d: ब्रह्मा॒णस् त्वा वयं॒ युजा॒ सोमपा॒म् इन्द्र सोमि॒नः । सुता॒वन्तो हवामहे ॥३॥
20.38.e: We, Soma-bearing Brāhmans, call thee, Soma-drinker, with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing juice expressed.

20.38.d: इ॒न्द्रम् इ॒द् गाथि॒नो बृह॒द् इ॒न्द्रम् अर्के॒भिर् अर्कि॒णः । इ॒न्द्रं वा॒णीर् अनूषत ॥४॥
20.38.e: Indra the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.

20.38.d: इ॒न्द्र इ॒द् ध॒र्योः स॒चा सं॒मिश्ल आ॒ वचोयु॒जा । इ॒न्द्रो वज्री॒ हिरण्य॒यः ॥५॥
20.38.e: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked: car, Indra, the golden, Thunder-armed.

20.38.d: इ॒न्द्रो दीर्घा॒य च॒क्षस आ॒ सू॒र्यं रोहयद् दिवि॒ । वि॒ गो॒भिर् अ॒द्रिम् ऐरयत् ॥६॥
20.38.e: Indra hath raised the Sun aloft in heaven that he may see afar. He burst the mountain for the kine.

20.39.d: इ॒न्द्रं वो विश्व॒तस् प॒रि ह॒वामहे ज॒नेभ्यः । अस्मा॒कम् अस्तु के॒वलः ॥१॥
20.39.e: For you, from every side, we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others', let him be.

20.39.d: व्य् अ॑न्त॒रिक्षम् अतिरन् म॒दे सो॒मस्य रोचना॒ । इ॒न्द्रो य॒द् अ॒भिनद् वल॒म् ॥२॥
20.39.e: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light. When he cleft Vala limb from limb.

20.39.d: उ॒द् गा॒ आजद् अ॒ङ्गिरोभ्य आवि॒ष् कृण्व॒न् गु॒हा सतीः॒ । अर्वा॒ञ्चं नुनुदे वल॒म् ॥३॥
20.39.e: Showing the hidden cows he draye them forth for the Angirases, And Vala he cast headlong down.

20.39.d: इ॒न्द्रेण रोचना॒ दिवो॒ दृल्हा॒नि दृंहिता॒नि च । स्थिरा॒णि न॒ पराणु॒दे ॥४॥
20.39.e: By Indra were the luminous realms of heaven established and secured, Firm and immovable from their place.

20.39.d: अपा॒म् ऊर्मि॒र् म॒दन्न् इव स्तो॒म इन्द्राजिरायते । वि॒ ते म॒दा अराजिषुः ॥५॥
20.39.e: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of waters: bright. Have shone the drops that gladden thee.

20.40.d: इ॒न्द्रेण सं॒ हि॒ दृ॒क्षसे संजग्मानो॒ अ॒बिभ्युषा॒ । मन्दू॒ समान॒वर्चसा ॥१॥
20.40.e: Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side: Both joyous: equal in your sheen.

20.40.d: अनवद्यै॒र् अभि॒द्युभिर् मखः॒ स॒हस्वद् अर्चति । गणै॒र् इ॒न्द्रस्य का॒म्यैः ॥२॥
20.40.e: With Indra's well-beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven, The sacrificer cries aloud.

20.40.d: आ॒द् अ॒ह स्वधा॒म् अ॒नु पु॒नर् गर्भत्व॒म् एरिरे॒ । द॒धाना ना॒म यज्ञि॒यम् ॥३॥
20.40.e: Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn, Assuming sacrificial name.

20.41.d: इ॒न्द्रो दधीचो॒ अस्थ॒भिर् वृत्रा॒ण्य् अ॒प्रतिष्कुतः । जघा॒न नवती॒र् न॒व ॥१॥
20.41.e: With bones of Dadhyach for his arms, Indra, resistless in attack, Struck nine-and-ninety Vritras dead,

20.41.d: इछ॒न् अ॒श्वस्य य॒च् छि॒रः प॒र्वतेष्व् अ॒पश्रितम् । त॒द् विदच् छर्यणा॒वति ॥२॥
20.41.e: He, searching for the horse's head, removed among the moun- tains, found At Saryanāvān what he sought.

20.41.d: अ॒त्रा॒ह गो॒र् अमन्वत ना॒म त्व॒ष्टुर् अपीच्य॑म् । इत्था॒ चन्द्र॒मसो गृहे॒ ॥३॥
20.41.e: Then verily they recognized the essential form of Tvashtar's Bull. Here in the mansion of the Moon.

20.42.d: वा॒चम् अष्टा॒पदीम् अहं॒ न॒वस्रक्तिम् ऋतस्पृ॒शम् । इ॒न्द्रात् प॒रि तन्व॑म् ममे ॥१॥
20.42.e: From Indra have I measured an eight-footed and nine-cornered. song, Delicate, faithful to the Law.

20.42.d: अ॒नु त्वा रो॒दसी उभे॒ क्र॒क्षमाणम् अकृपेताम् । इ॒न्द्र य॒द् दस्युहा॒भवः ॥२॥
20.42.e: Indra, both worlds complained to thee when uttering thy fearful roar, What time thou smotest Dasyus dead.

20.42.d: उत्तिष्ठन्न् ओ॒जसा सह॒ पीत्वी॒ शि॒प्रे अवेपयः । सो॒मम् इन्द्र चमू॒ सुत॒म् ॥३॥
20.42.e: Arising in thy might thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having quaffed The Soma poured into the bowls.

20.43.d: भिन्धि॒ वि॒श्वा अ॒प द्वि॒षः बा॒धो जही॒ मृ॒धः । व॒सु स्पार्हं॒ त॒द् आ॒ भर ॥१॥
20.43.e: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long;

20.43.d: य॒द् वीला॒व् इन्द्र य॒त् स्थिरे॒ य॒त् प॒र्शाने प॒राभृतम् । व॒सु स्पार्हं॒ त॒द् आ॒ भर ॥२॥
20.43.e: O Indra, that which is concealed in firm strong place precipitous: Bring us the wealth for which we long:

20.43.d: य॒स्य ते विश्व॒मानुषो भू॒रेर् दत्त॒स्य वे॒दति । व॒सु स्पार्हं॒ त॒द् आ॒ भर ॥३॥
20.43.e: Great riches which the world of men shall recognize as sent by thee: Bring us the wealth for which we long,

20.44.d: प्र॒ सम्रा॒जं चर्षणीना॒म् इ॒न्द्रं स्तोता न॒व्यं गीर्भिः । न॒रं नृषा॒हं मं॒हिष्ठम् ॥१॥
20.44.e: Praise Indra whom our songs must laud, great Sovran of man- kind, the Chief Most liberal who controlleth men.

20.44.d: य॒स्मिन्न् उक्था॒नि र॒ण्यन्ति वि॒श्वानि च श्रवस्य । अपा॒म् अ॒वो न॒ समुद्रे॒ ॥२॥
20.44.e: In whom the hymns of praise delight, and all the glory-giving songs, Like the flood's longing for the sea.

20.44.d: तं॒ सुष्टुत्या॒ विवासे ज्येष्ठरा॒जं भ॒रे कृत्नु॒म् । महो॒ वाजि॒नं सनि॒भ्यः ॥३॥
20.44.e: Him I invite with eulogy, best King, effective in the fight, Strong for the gain of mighty spoil.

20.45.d: अय॒म् उ ते स॒म् अतसि कपो॒त इव गर्भधि॒म् । व॒चस् त॒च् चिन् न ओहसे ॥१॥
20.45.e: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as the dove turneth to his mate. Thou carest too for this our prayer.

20.45.d: स्तोत्रं॒ राधानां पते गि॒र्वाहो वीर य॒स्य ते । वि॒भूतिर् अस्तु सूनृ॒ता ॥२॥
20.45.e: O Hero, Lord of Bounties, praised in hymns, may power and pleasantness Be his who signs the laud to thee.

20.45.d: ऊर्ध्व॒स् तिष्ठा न ऊत॒ये ऽस्मि॒न् वा॒जे शतक्रतो । स॒म् अन्ये॒षु ब्रवावहै ॥३॥
20.45.e: Lord of a Hundred Powers, stand up to lend us succour in this fight: In others too let us agree.

20.46.d: प्रणेता॒रम् व॒स्यो अ॒छा क॒र्तारं ज्यो॒तिः सम॒त्सु । सासह्वां॒सम् युधा॒मि॒त्रान् ॥१॥
20.46.e: Him who advances men to wealth, sends light to lead them in their wars, And quells their foemen in the fray:

20.46.d: स॒ नः प॒प्रिः पारयाति स्वस्ति॒ नावा॒ पुरुहूतः॒ । इ॒न्द्रो वि॒श्वा अ॒ति द्वि॒षः ॥२॥
20.46.e: May he, the saviour much-invoked, may Indra bear us in a ship Safely beyond all enemies.

20.46.d: स॒ त्वं॒ न इन्द्र वा॒जोभिर् दशस्या॒ च गातुया॒ च । अ॒छा च नः सुम्नं॒ नेषि ॥३॥
20.46.e: As such, O Indra, honour us with wealth and treasure: further us, And lead us to felicity.

20.47.d: त॒म् इ॒न्द्रं वाजयामसि महे॒ वृत्रा॒य ह॒न्तवे । स॒ वृ॒षा वृषभो॒ भुवत् ॥१॥
20.47.e: We make this Indra show his strength, to strike the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous Hero shall he be.

20.47.d: इ॒न्द्रः स॒ दा॒मने कृत॒ ओ॒जिष्ठः स॒ म॒दे हितः॒ । द्युम्नी॒ श्लोकी॒ स॒ सोम्यः॒ ॥२॥
20.47.e: Indra was made for giving, most powerful, friendly in carouse, Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.

20.47.d: गिरा॒ व॒ज्रो न॒ सं॒भृतः स॒बलो अ॒नपच्युतः । ववक्ष॒ ऋष्वो॒ अ॒स्तृतः ॥३॥
20.47.e: By song, as 'twere, the mighty bolt, which none may parry, was prepared: Lofty, invincible he grew.

20.47.d: इ॒न्द्रम् इ॒द् गाथि॒नो बृह॒द् इ॒न्द्रम् अर्के॒भिर् अर्कि॒णः । इ॒न्द्रं वा॒णीर् अनूषत ॥४॥
इ॒न्द्र इ॒द् ध॒र्योः स॒चा सं॒मिश्ल आ॒ वचोयु॒जा । इ॒न्द्रो वज्री॒ हिरण्य॒यः ॥५॥
इ॒न्द्रो दीर्घा॒य च॒क्षस आ॒ सू॒र्यं रोहयद् दिवि॒ । वि॒ गो॒भिर् अ॒द्रिम् ऐरयत् ॥६॥
आ॒ याहि सुषुमा॒ हि॒ त इ॒न्द्र सो॒मं पि॒बा इम॒म् । ए॒दं॒ बर्हिः॒ सदो म॒म ॥७॥
आ॒ त्वा ब्रह्मयु॒जा ह॒री व॒हताम् इन्द्र केशि॒ना । उ॒प ब्र॒ह्माणि नः शृणु ॥८॥
ब्रह्मा॒णस् त्वा वयं॒ युजा॒ सोमपा॒म् इन्द्र सोमि॒नः । सुता॒वन्तो हवामहे ॥९॥
युञ्ज॒न्ति ब्रध्न॒म् अरुषं॒ च॒रन्तं प॒रि तस्थु॒षः । रो॒चन्ते रोचना॒ दिवि॒ ॥१०॥
20.47.e: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed: The lights are shining in the sky.

20.47.d: युञ्ज॒न्त्य् अस्य का॒म्या ह॒री वि॒पक्षसा र॒थे । शो॒णा धृष्णू॒ नृवा॒हसा ॥११॥
20.47.e: They yoke on both sides to the car the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.

20.47.d: केतुं॒ कृण्व॒न्न् अकेत॒वे पे॒शो मर्या अपेश॒से । स॒म् उष॒द्भिर् अजायथाः ॥१२॥
20.47.e: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O Men r where no form was, Wast born together with the Dawns,

20.47.d: उ॒द् उ त्यं॒ जात॒वेदसं देवं॒ वहन्ति केत॒वः । दृशे॒ वि॒श्वाय सू॒र्यम् ॥१३॥
20.47.e: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that= is, Sūrya, that every one may see.

20.47.d: अ॒प त्ये॒ ताय॒वो यथा न॒क्षत्रा यन्त्य् अक्तु॒भिः । सू॒राय विश्व॒चक्षसे ॥१४॥
20.47.e: The constellations pass away, like thieves, together with their- beams, Before the all-beholding Sun.

20.47.d: अ॒दृश्रन्न् अस्य केत॒वो वि॒ रश्म॒यो ज॒नां अ॒नु । भ्रा॒जन्तो अग्न॒यो यथा ॥१५॥
20.47.e: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o'er the world of men, Like fiery flames that burn and blaze.

20.47.d: तर॒णिर् विश्व॒दर्शतो ज्योतिष्कृ॒द् असि सूर्य । वि॒श्वम् आ॒ भासि रोचन ॥१६॥
20.47.e: Swift and all-beautiful art thou, O Sūrya, maker of the light. Illuming all the radiant realm.

20.47.d: प्रत्य॒ङ् देवा॒नां वि॒शः प्रत्य॒ङ्ङ् उ॒द् एषि मा॒नुषीः । प्रत्य॒ङ् वि॒श्वं स्व॑र् दृशे॒ ॥१७॥
20.47.e: Thou guest to the troops of Gods, thou comest hither to man- kind, Hither, all light for us to see.

20.47.d: ये॒ना पावक च॒क्षसा भुरण्य॒न्तं ज॒नां अ॒नु । त्वं॒ वरुण प॒श्यसि ॥१८॥
20.47.e: Thou with that eye of thine wherewith thou seest, brilliant. Varuna, The active one throughout mankind.

20.47.d: वि॒ द्याम् एषि र॒जस् पृथ्व् अ॒हर् मि॒मानो अक्तु॒भिः । प॒श्यं ज॒न्मानि सूर्य ॥१९॥
20.47.e: Pervadest heaven and wide mid-air, melting the days out with. thy beams, Sun, seeing all things that have birth.

20.47.d: सप्त॒ त्वा हरि॒तो र॒थे व॒हन्ति देव सूर्य । शोचि॒ष्केशम् विचक्षण॒म् ॥२०॥
20.47.e: Seven bay steeds, harnessed to thy car, bear thee, O.thou far- seeing One, God, Sūrya, thee with radiant hair.

20.47.d: अ॒युक्त सप्त॒ शुन्ध्यु॒वः सू॒रो र॒थस्य नप्त्यः॑ । ता॒भिर् याति स्व॒युक्तिभिः ॥२१॥
20.47.e: Sūrya hath yoked the seven bright mares, the daughters of the car: With these, His own dear team, he travelleth.

20.48.d: अभि॒ त्वा व॒र्चसा गि॒रः सिञ्च॒न्त्य् आ॒ चरण्यु॒वः । अभि॒ वत्सं॒ न॒ धेन॒वः ॥१॥
20.48.e: The swiftly-moving songs of praise pour on thee streams of vital strength As mother cows refresh the calf.

20.48.d: ता॒ अर्षन्ति शुभ्रि॒यः पृञ्चती॒र् व॒र्चसा प॒यः । जातं॒ ज॒निर् य॒था हृदा॒ ॥२॥
20.48.e: Swift move the bright ones while they blend the Milk with vital vigour, as A dame her infant with her heart.

20.48.d: व॒ज्रापवसा॒ध्यः कीर्ति॒र् म्रिय॒माणम् आ॒वहन् । म॒ह्यम् आ॒युर् घृतं॒ प॒यः ॥३॥
20.48.e: Fair hymns bring glory to the Strong, and Indra-vigour; unto, me Fatness and milk and length of days.

20.48.d: आ॒यं॒ गौः॒ पृ॒श्निर् अक्रमीद् अ॒सदन् मात॒रं पुरः॒ । पित॒रं च प्रय॒न्त् स्वः॑ ॥४॥
20.48.e: This brindled Bull hath come and sat before the Mother in the east, Advancing to the Father Heaven.

20.48.d: अन्त॒श् चरति रोचना॒ अस्य॒ प्राणा॒द् अपानतः॒ । व्य् अ॑ख्यन् महिषः॒ स्वः॑ ॥५॥
20.48.e: As expiration from breath she moves along the lucid spheres: The Bull shines forth through all the sky.

20.48.d: त्रिंश॒द् धा॒मा वि॒ राजति वा॒क् पतङ्गो॒ अशिश्रियत् । प्र॒ति व॒स्तोर् अ॒हर् द्यु॒भिः ॥६॥
20.48.e: Song is bestowed upon the Bird. It reigns supreme throughout thirty realms Throughout the days at break of morn.

20.49.d: य॒च् छक्रा॒ वा॒चम् आ॒रुहन्न् अन्त॒रिक्षं सिषासथः । सं॒ देवा॒ अमदन् वृ॒षा ॥१॥
20.49.e: When voices, fain to win mid-air, ascended to the Mighty One, The vigorous God was filled with joy.

20.49.d: शक्रो॒ वा॒चम् अ॒धृष्टायो॒र् उवाचो अ॒धृष्णुहि । मं॒हिष्ठ आ॒ मदर्दि॒वि ॥२॥
20.49.e: Praise with the voice the Mighty, praise the awful with the voice: in heaven He, the most bounteous, hath been glad.

20.49.d: शक्रो॒ वा॒चम् अ॒धृष्णुहि धा॒मधर्मन् वि॒ राजति । वि॒मदन् बर्हि॒र् आ॒सरन् ॥३॥
20.49.e: Praise with the voice the Mighty: he rules in each realm. In transport he Hath set upon the sacred grass.

20.49.d: तं॒ वो दस्म॒म् ऋतीष॒हं व॒सोर् मन्दान॒म् अ॒न्धसः । अभि॒ वत्सं॒ न॒ स्व॒सरेषु धेन॒व इ॒न्द्रं गीर्भि॒र् नवामहे ॥४॥
20.49.e: As cows low to their calf in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delightful juice.

20.49.d: द्युक्षं॒ सुदा॒नुं त॒विषीभिर् आ॒वृतम् गिरिं॒ न॒ पुरुभो॒जसम् । क्षुम॒न्तं वा॒जं शति॒नं सहस्रि॒णं मक्षू॒ गो॒मन्तम् ईमहे ॥५॥
20.49.e: Celestial, bounteous Giver, God, with power and might, rich, mountain-like, in precious things. Him soon we see for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.

20.49.d: त॒त् त्वा यामि सुवी॒र्यं त॒द् ब्र॒ह्म पूर्व॒चित्तये । ये॒ना य॒तिभ्यो भृ॒गवे ध॒ने हिते॒ ये॒न प्र॒स्कण्वम् आ॒विथ ॥६॥
20.49.e: I crave of thee that hero strength—that thou mayst first regard this prayer Wherewith thou helpest Bhrigu and the Yatis and Praskanva when the prize was staked.

20.49.d: ये॒ना समुद्र॒म् अ॒सृजो मही॒र् अप॒स् त॒द् इन्द्र वृ॒ष्णि ते श॒वः । सद्यः॒ सो॒ अस्य महिमा॒ न॒ संन॒शे यं॒ क्षोणी॒र् अनुचक्रदे॒ ॥७॥
20.49.e: Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea—Indra, that manly strength of thine. For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds have cried aloud.

20.50.d: क॒न् न॒व्यो अतसी॒नां तुरो॒ गृणीत म॒र्त्यः । नही॒ न्व् अ॑स्य महिमा॒नम् इन्द्रियं॒ स्व॑र् गृण॒न्त आनशुः॒ ॥१॥
20.50.e: What newest of imploring hymns shall, then, the zealous mortal sing? For have not they who laud his might and Indra-power won for themselves the light of heaven?

20.50.d: क॒द् उ स्तुव॒न्त ऋतयन्त देव॒त ऋ॒षिः को॒ वि॒प्र ओहते । कदा॒ ह॒वं मघवन्न् इन्द्र सुन्वतः॒ क॒द् उ स्तुवत॒ आ॒ गमः ॥२॥
20.50.e: When shall they keep the Law and praise thee mid the Gods? Who counts as Rishi and as sage? When wilt thou ever, Indra, Bounteous Lord, come nigh to presser's or to praiser's call?

20.51.d: अभि॒ प्र॒ वः सुरा॒धसम् इ॒न्द्रम् अर्च य॒था विदे॒ । यो॒ जरितृ॒भ्यो मघ॒वा पुरूव॒सुः सह॒स्रेणेव शिक्षति ॥१॥
20.51.e: For you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know; Praise of the Bounteous Lord who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.

20.51.d: शता॒नीकेव प्र॒ जिगाति धृष्णुया॒ हन्ति वृत्रा॒णि दाशु॒षे । गिरे॒र् इव प्र॒ र॒सा अस्य पिन्विरे द॒त्राणि पुरुभो॒जसः ॥२॥
20.51.e: As with a hundred hosts he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes. As from a mountain flow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one.

20.51.d: प्र॒ सु॒ श्रुतं॒ सुरा॒धसम् अ॒र्चा शक्र॒म् अभि॒ष्टये । यः॒ सुन्वते॒ स्तुवते॒ का॒म्यं व॒सु सह॒स्रेणेव मं॒हते ॥३॥
20.51.e: Sakra I praise, for victory, far-famed, exceeding bountiful. Who gives, as 'twere in thousands, precious wealth to him who sheds the juice and worships him.

20.51.d: शता॒नीका हेत॒यो अस्य दुष्ट॒रा इ॒न्द्रस्य समि॒षो महीः॒ । गिरि॒र् न॒ भुज्मा॒ मघ॒त्सु पिन्वते य॒द् ईं सुता॒ अ॒मन्दिषुः ॥४॥
20.51.e: Arrows with hundred points, unconquerable, are this Indra's mighty arms in war. He streams on liberal worshippers like a hill with springs, when juices poured have gladdened him.

20.52.d: वयं॒ घ त्वा सुता॒वन्त आ॒पो न॒ वृक्त॒बर्हिषः । पवि॒त्रस्य प्रस्र॒वणेषु वृत्रहन् प॒रि स्तोता॒र आसते ॥१॥
20.52.e: We compass thee like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream thy worshipper round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit.

20.52.d: स्व॒रन्ति त्वा सुते॒ न॒रो व॒सो निरेक॒ उक्थि॒नः । कदा॒ सुतं॒ तृषाण॒ ओक आ॒ गम इ॒न्द्र स्वब्दी॒व वं॒सगः ॥२॥
20.52.e: Men, Vasu! by the Soma, with lauds call thee to the foremost place. When comest thou athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?

20.52.d: क॒ण्वेभिर् धृष्णव् आ॒ धृस॒द् वा॒जं दर्षि सहस्रि॒णम् । पिश॒ङ्गरूपं मघवन् विचर्षणे मक्षू॒ गो॒मन्तम् ईमहे ॥३॥

20.53.d: क॒ ईं वेद सुते॒ स॒चा पि॒बन्तं क॒द् व॒यो दधे । अयं॒ यः॒ पु॒रो विभिन॒त्त्य् ओ॒जसा मन्दानः॒ शिप्र्य् अ॒न्धसः ॥१॥
20.53.e: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-cheeked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.

20.53.d: दाना॒ मृगो॒ न॒ वारणः॒ पुरुत्रा॒ चर॒थं दधे । न॒किष् ट्वा नि॒ यमद् आ॒ सुते॒ गमो महा॒श् चरस्य् ओ॒जसा ॥२॥
20.53.e: As a wild elephant rushes on, this way and that way, mad with heat. None may restrain thee; yet come hither to the draught: thou movest mighty in thy power.

20.53.d: य॒ उग्रः॒ स॒न्न् अ॒निष्टृत स्थिरो॒ र॒णाय सं॒स्कृतः । य॒दि स्तोतु॒र् मघ॒वा शृण॒वद् ध॒वं ने॒न्द्रो योषत्य् आ॒ गमत् ॥३॥
20.53.e: When he, the mighty, ne'er o'erthrown, stedfast, made ready for the fight. When Indra, Bounteous Lord, lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come.

20.54.d: वि॒श्वाः पृ॒तना अभिभू॒तरं न॒रं सजू॒स् ततक्षुर् इ॒न्द्रं जजनु॒श् च राज॒से । क्र॒त्वा व॒रिष्ठं व॒र आमु॒रिम् उतो॒ग्र॒म् ओ॒जिष्ठं तव॒सं तरस्वि॒नम् ॥१॥
20.54.e: Of one accord they made and formed for kingship Indra, the Hero who in all encounters overcometh, Most eminent for power, destroyer in the conflict, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.

20.54.d: स॒म् ईं रेभा॒सो अस्वरन्न् इ॒न्द्रं सो॒मस्य पीत॒ये । स्व॑र्पतिं य॒द् ईं वृधे॒ धृत॒व्रतो ह्य् ओ॒जसा स॒म् ऊति॒भिः ॥२॥
